title: Corrugated Fibreboard Boxes — Specification: Part 1 for General Packaging
summary: Mandatory specification for corrugated fibreboard shipping containers, defining bursting strength, edge crush resistance, and moisture limits.
scope: Covers requirements for corrugated fibreboard boxes made from kraft paper used for packaging and domestic transportation of goods.

clauses.title: Board Construction and Fluting
clauses.content: Boxes shall be manufactured from A, B, C, or E flute corrugated fibreboard with uniform adhesive bond.
clauses.testRequirement: Pin adhesion test >= 40 N/100mm flute length per IS 4006.
clauses.testMethod: Pin adhesion test >= 40 N/100mm flute length per IS 4006.

clauses.title: Bursting Strength and Edge Crush Test (ECT)
clauses.content: Single wall board bursting strength shall be not less than 700 kPa to 1800 kPa. Minimum ECT shall be 3.5 kN/m.
clauses.testRequirement: Mullen bursting test and ECT per IS 7063.
clauses.testMethod: Mullen bursting test and ECT per IS 7063.

title: Corrugated Fibreboard Boxes — Part 2: Packaging of Heavy and Export Goods
summary: Defines double and triple wall heavy-duty corrugated cartons engineered for export cargo, vibration resistance, and stacking loads.
scope: Applies to double-wall and triple-wall corrugated fibreboard boxes for transport of heavy industrial equipment.

clauses.title: Box Compression Test (BCT)
clauses.content: Box compression strength under static load shall withstand minimum 5.0 kN without side wall buckling.

title: Methods of Sampling and Test for Paper and Allied Products — Part 1
summary: Standard test methods for grammage (GSM), thickness, tensile strength, and moisture conditioning of paper packaging specimens.
scope: Prescribes methods for sampling and test for paper, board, and allied pulp packaging materials.

clauses.title: Standard Atmosphere for Conditioning
clauses.content: Test specimens shall be conditioned at (27 ± 2)°C and (65 ± 5)% relative humidity.

clauses.title: Determination of Grammage (GSM)
clauses.content: Grammage determined on 10 conditioned test sheets using precision balance calibrated to 0.01 g.

title: Methods of Sampling and Test for Paper and Allied Products — Part 2: Chemical Tests
summary: Standard chemical testing methods for paper, determining ash content, water-soluble acidity/alkalinity, and starch content.
scope: Covers quantitative chemical methods of test for paper, board and converted pulp packaging articles.

clauses.title: Ash Content Determination
clauses.content: Ash content determination at 900°C in muffle furnace shall not exceed specified grade threshold.

title: Guidelines for Recovery and Recycling of Plastics Waste
summary: Mandatory standard establishing the 1 to 7 polymer identification numbering and recycling symbols for Indian packaging.
scope: Prescribes guidelines for selection, segregation and recycling of plastics waste and resin identification coding (RIC).

clauses.title: Resin Identification Coding (1-7)
clauses.content: Every plastic container shall have an embossed recycling triangle mark with resin code: 1 (PET), 2 (HDPE), 3 (PVC), 4 (LDPE), 5 (PP), 6 (PS), 7 (OTHER).

clauses.title: Prohibition in Food Contact
clauses.content: Recycled plastics shall not be used in packaging meant for storing, carrying, or dispensing foodstuffs without specific FSSAI approval.

title: Polyethylene for Safe Use in Contact with Foodstuffs, Pharmaceuticals and Drinking Water
summary: Specifies purity, residual catalyst limits, and additive restrictions for polyethylene polymers in food and pharmaceutical packaging.
scope: Covers low-density polyethylene (LDPE), linear low-density polyethylene (LLDPE), and high-density polyethylene (HDPE) for food contact.

clauses.title: Overall Migration Limit
clauses.content: Overall migration of polymer constituents shall not exceed 60 mg/kg or 10 mg/dm² of food contact surface area.

title: Determination of Overall Migration of Constituents of Plastics Materials for Food Contact
summary: Prescribes standard laboratory extraction methods for determining overall extractive migration limits into food simulants.
scope: Applies to all plastic materials, containers, lids, closures, and laminates intended for food packaging.

clauses.title: Simulant Exposure Conditions
clauses.content: Aqueous foods: distilled water (40°C, 10 days); Acidic foods: 3% acetic acid; Alcoholic: 15% ethanol; Fatty foods: purified n-heptane.

title: Kraft Paper — Specification (Plain and Ribbed)
summary: Specifies bursting factor, tear factor, Cobb value (water absorptiveness), and tensile strength for kraft paper grades.
scope: Covers requirements for four grades of unbleached and bleached kraft paper used in packing, envelopes, and multiwall sacks.

clauses.title: Burst Factor and Cobb Sizing Test
clauses.content: Grade 1 kraft paper burst factor shall be minimum 28. Cobb 60 water absorption shall not exceed 25 g/m².

title: Printing Ink for Food Packaging — Code of Practice
summary: Mandatory prohibition of toluene, phthalates, and toxic heavy metals in printing inks used for food packaging in India.
scope: Prescribes raw material restrictions and exclusion lists for printing inks applied to the external surfaces of food packages.

clauses.title: Exclusion of Toluene and Hazardous Solvents
clauses.content: Toluene, mineral oils containing PAH, and lead chromate pigments are strictly prohibited in formulation.

title: Styrene Polymers for Safe Use in Contact with Foodstuffs, Pharmaceuticals and Drinking Water
summary: Specifies residual monomer limits for polystyrene (PS) and high-impact polystyrene (HIPS) used in food and dairy packaging.
scope: Covers polystyrene homopolymers and copolymers intended for packaging food, pharmaceuticals, and potable water.

clauses.title: Residual Styrene Monomer Limit
clauses.content: Residual styrene monomer content shall not exceed 0.2 percent (2000 ppm) by mass.

title: Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) and Its Copolymers for Safe Contact with Foodstuffs
summary: Mandatory limits on vinyl chloride monomer (VCM) and plasticizer migration in PVC blister foils and food films.
scope: Specifies requirements for PVC resins and compounded materials used for packaging pharmaceuticals and foodstuffs.

clauses.title: Residual Vinyl Chloride Monomer (VCM)
clauses.content: Residual VCM in polymer shall not exceed 1.0 mg/kg; migration into food shall not exceed 0.01 mg/kg.

title: Polypropylene for Safe Use in Contact with Foodstuffs, Pharmaceuticals and Drinking Water
summary: Specifies extraction limits and additive restrictions for polypropylene (PP) food containers and caps.
scope: Applies to polypropylene homopolymers and block/random copolymers intended for direct food packaging.

clauses.title: Extractive and Hexane Soluble Limits
clauses.content: Hexane extractable fraction at 50°C shall not exceed 6.4% by mass for homopolymer PP.

title: Polyalkylene Terephthalates (PET and PBT) for Contact with Foodstuffs
summary: Mandatory specification for PET and PBT resins used in mineral water bottles, edible oil jars, and beverage containers.
scope: Covers polyethylene terephthalate (PET) polymers and compounds for food and potable water packaging.

clauses.title: Acetaldehyde and Heavy Metal Content
clauses.content: Acetaldehyde level in PET preforms shall not exceed 3.0 ppm to avoid beverage taste alteration.

title: Textile — HDPE / PP Woven Sacks for Packaging
summary: Mandatory standard for HDPE and PP woven bags used for packaging 50kg cement, fertilizers, sugar, and grains.
scope: Specifies construction, breaking strength, UV stabilization, and drop impact tests for woven polymer sacks.

clauses.title: Breaking Strength and Drop Impact Test
clauses.content: Woven sack breaking strength >= 850 N lengthwise; must survive flat and side drops from 1.2 m height without bursting.

title: Biaxially Oriented Polypropylene (BOPP) Films for Packaging — Specification
summary: Standard for plain, heat-sealable, and metallized BOPP films used in snack food wrapping, tape backing, and laminations.
scope: Specifies tensile strength, haze, optical density, and heat-seal strength of BOPP packaging films.

clauses.title: Heat Seal Strength and Tensile Modulus
clauses.content: Minimum heat seal strength shall be 2.0 N/15mm at 120°C sealing temperature.

title: Aluminium Foil for Pharmaceutical Packaging — Specification
summary: Specifies pinhole density, bursting strength, water vapor transmission rate (WVTR), and heat-seal lacquer adhesion for pharma blister foils.
scope: Applies to hard and soft tempered aluminium foil from 0.020 mm to 0.040 mm for pharmaceutical packaging.

clauses.title: Pinhole Count Limit
clauses.content: Number of pinholes per square metre shall be zero for thickness 0.025 mm and above under 1000 lux illumination.

title: Stainless Steel Vacuum Flasks and Insulated Containers — Specification
qcoReference: Cookware, Utensils and Insulated Flasks (Quality Control) Order, 2023 (DPIIT)
qcoOrder: Cookware, Utensils and Insulated Flasks (Quality Control) Order, 2023 (DPIIT)
summary: Mandatory standard for stainless steel insulated bottles and vacuum flasks, governing food-grade SS 304 inner liner purity, thermal insulation retention (hot/cold for 24h), drop impact, and leak-proof gasket seals.
scope: Covers stainless steel double-walled vacuum insulated flasks, bottles, carafes, and sippers intended for carrying hot or cold potable beverages.

clauses.title: Scope & Product Applicability
clauses.content: This standard prescribes the requirements, construction, thermal insulation performance, and methods of sampling and test for stainless steel double-walled vacuum flasks and insulated containers of capacity up to 10 litres intended for domestic, institutional, and outdoor conveyance of potable liquids.

clauses.title: Normative References
clauses.content: The standards listed (IS 6911 for stainless steel sheets, IS 9845 for plastic migration testing, IS 10910 for polypropylene contact, IS 4905 for random sampling) contain provisions which constitute essential requirements of this standard.

clauses.title: Terminology & Constructional Design
clauses.content: A double-walled insulated container comprises an inner fluid vessel and an outer protective shell separated by an evacuated interstitial space with high vacuum (< 10^-4 mbar) sealed by brazing or welding. An effective closure device with food-grade elastomer seal prevents fluid leakage.

clauses.title: Nominal Capacity & Tolerances (Table 1)
clauses.content: The actual liquid capacity when filled to within 12 mm from the top of the neck shall not deviate from the marked nominal capacity by more than +/- 5% for capacities up to 1000 ml (+/- 3% for above 1000 ml). Minimum thickness of inner wall shall be 0.40 mm.

clauses.title: Material Chemical Composition (Table 2)
clauses.content: The inner vessel in direct contact with beverages shall be manufactured from austenitic stainless steel Grade 304 (X04Cr19Ni9) or Grade 316 conforming to IS 6911. Scrap or radioactive steel is strictly prohibited.
clauses.testRequirement: XRF or OES chemical analysis for Nickel (min 8.0%) and Chromium (min 17.5%).
clauses.testMethod: XRF or OES chemical analysis for Nickel (min 8.0%) and Chromium (min 17.5%).

clauses.title: Surface Finish, Welds & Acid Passivation
clauses.content: Internal surfaces of the inner container shall be smoothly finished, electropolished, and free from cracks, burrs, oxide scales, or deep weld pits. All inner seams shall be passivated with nitric/citric acid bath to ensure no rust or heavy metal leaches into potable liquids.

clauses.title: Thermal Insulation Retention Performance (Table 3)
clauses.content: When filled with boiling potable water at 95°C and sealed in an ambient environment maintained at 20°C +/- 2°C, the water temperature inside the container shall remain >= 60°C after 6 hours (and >= 45°C after 24 hours). For cold retention, water filled at 4°C shall remain <= 10°C after 6 hours.
clauses.testRequirement: Calibrated multi-channel thermocouple datalogger test per Section 7.
clauses.testMethod: Calibrated multi-channel thermocouple datalogger test per Section 7.

clauses.title: Gasket Sealing & Inversion Hydrostatic Leak Test
clauses.content: The bottle closure gasket shall be made of food-grade silicone conforming to IS 9845. When filled to nominal capacity with hot water at 80°C and inverted upside-down for 10 continuous minutes, the closure shall show ZERO droplets, moisture seepage, or pressure loss.
clauses.testRequirement: Inversion hydrostatic seal test at 80°C under 1000 lux inspection.
clauses.testMethod: Inversion hydrostatic seal test at 80°C under 1000 lux inspection.

clauses.title: Mechanical Drop Impact & Handle Attachment Test
clauses.content: The container filled to nominal capacity with water at room temperature shall be dropped freely from a height of 1.0 m onto a rigid flat concrete anvil. After impact, there shall be no fracture, leakage, or loss of vacuum insulation. Handles shall withstand 20 kg static tensile pull for 5 minutes.
clauses.testRequirement: Guided 1.0-metre drop tester and tensile handle pull rig.
clauses.testMethod: Guided 1.0-metre drop tester and tensile handle pull rig.

clauses.title: Sampling, Batch Criteria & Scheme of Testing (STI)
clauses.content: Sampling shall be carried out in accordance with IS 4905. For daily factory batch testing under the BIS STI, routine tests (visual, capacity, leak test, thermal check) shall be conducted on 1 in every 500 units produced. Routine records must be preserved for 3 years.

clauses.title: Mandatory Marking, Laser Embossing & Labelling
clauses.content: Each container shall be permanently laser-engraved or embossed with: (a) BIS Standard Mark (ISI Logo) with License Number CM/L-XXXXXXXXXX, (b) Nominal capacity in ml, (c) Food Grade SS 304 mark, (d) Manufacturer name/trademark, (e) Month and Year of manufacture, and (f) Batch/Lot code.

title: Stainless Steel Plate, Sheet and Strip — Specification
qcoReference: Stainless Steel Products Quality Control Order
qcoOrder: Stainless Steel Products Quality Control Order
summary: Mandatory standard for food-grade austenitic stainless steel sheets, plates, and strips (Grade 304, 316) used for manufacturing steel bottles, cookware, and hospital equipment.
scope: Covers chemical and mechanical requirements for hot-rolled and cold-rolled stainless steel sheets and coils.

clauses.title: Chemical Composition for Food Contact (SS 304)
clauses.content: Grade 304 (X04Cr19Ni9): Carbon <= 0.07%, Chromium 17.5-19.5%, Nickel 8.0-10.5%. Strictly prohibited from using radioactive or toxic scrap.

clauses.title: Tensile Strength and Elongation
clauses.content: Tensile strength shall be between 520 and 750 MPa with minimum elongation of 40% for deep drawing bottle bodies.

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets of Rated Voltage up to 250 V and Rated Current up to 16 A
summary: Mandatory Indian Standard for all single-phase plugs, sockets, and adaptors. Strictly requires solid earth pins on 16A units and shuttered sockets.
scope: Applies to plugs, fixed and portable socket-outlets for a.c. up to 250 V and 16 A.

clauses.title: Standard Ratings (6A, 10A, 16A)
clauses.content: Standard ratings are 250V a.c., with rated current limited strictly to 6A, 10A, or 16A. Non-standard ratings are prohibited.

clauses.title: Earthing Contact Requirement
clauses.content: 16A accessories must have an earthing contact. 2-pin non-earthed configurations are only permitted for 6A or 2.5A flat reversible plugs.

clauses.title: Glow-Wire Test (850°C)
clauses.content: Insulating parts retaining current-carrying contacts must pass 850°C glow-wire test without sustained flame.

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — General Requirements
summary: Primary safety standard covering household electrical appliances, mandating leakage current limits (0.75 mA for Class I) and thermal protection.
scope: Deals with electrical, mechanical, thermal, and fire safety of domestic appliances with rated voltage up to 250 V single phase.

clauses.title: Operating Leakage Current
clauses.content: Leakage current under normal operation shall not exceed: Class I portable: 0.75 mA; Class 0/II: 0.25 mA; Class I stationary: 0.75 mA/kW.

title: Safety of Household Appliances — Part 2-3: Electric Irons
summary: Mandatory particular safety requirements for dry and steam electric irons, including soleplate drop tests and thermostat cut-outs.
scope: Applies to electric dry irons and steam irons for household use.

clauses.title: Soleplate Temperature Rise
clauses.content: Maximum soleplate temperature shall not exceed 250°C during maximum thermostat setting under continuous heating.

title: Safety of Household Appliances — Part 2-21: Stationary Storage Water Heaters (Geysers)
summary: Mandatory safety requirements for water heaters, requiring pressure relief valves, non-self-resetting thermal cutouts, and 8-bar pressure ratings.
scope: Applies to stationary electric storage water heaters intended for heating water below boiling temperature.

clauses.title: Rated Pressure and Safety Relief
clauses.content: Water heaters shall withstand 1.5 times the rated water pressure without leakage or permanent tank deformation.

title: Safety of Household Appliances — Part 2-201: Electric Immersion Water Heaters
summary: Mandatory standard for portable electric immersion water heaters, requiring water level markings and IPX7 immersion protection.
scope: Applies to portable electric immersion heaters intended for heating liquids in domestic vessels.

clauses.title: Minimum/Maximum Water Level Marking
clauses.content: The heating tube shall be clearly marked with indelible rings indicating minimum and maximum permissible immersion depths.

title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V
summary: Mandatory standard for single and multi-core PVC insulated copper and aluminium power wires and flexible cords up to 1.1 kV.
scope: Covers conductors, insulation thickness, spark testing, flammability, and high voltage tests for building wires.

clauses.title: Conductor Purity (Electrolytic Copper >= 99.9%)
clauses.content: Conductors shall consist of high conductivity annealed plain or tinned copper conforming to IS 8130.

clauses.title: Continuous Online Spark Testing
clauses.content: Every core of cable shall be subjected to online high-voltage spark testing up to 10 kV a.c. peak during insulation extrusion.

title: Crosslinked Polyethylene (XLPE) Insulated PVC Sheathed Cables — Part 1: up to 1100 V
summary: Mandatory standard for heavy-duty industrial and underground distribution cables with XLPE insulation rated up to 90°C.
scope: Covers single, two, three, three-and-a-half and four-core XLPE armoured and unarmoured cables.

clauses.title: Hot Set Test for XLPE
clauses.content: XLPE insulation elongation under 20 N/cm² load at 200°C shall not exceed 175%; permanent elongation after cooling <= 15%.

title: Conductors for Insulated Electric Cables and Flexible Cords — Specification
summary: Specifies maximum permissible electrical resistance (Ohm/km) and physical wire gauges for copper and aluminium cable conductors.
scope: Covers solid, stranded, and flexible copper and aluminium conductors for all insulated electrical cables.

clauses.title: Maximum D.C. Resistance at 20°C
clauses.content: Conductor DC resistance shall not exceed values in Table 1 (e.g., 1.5 sq mm copper <= 12.1 Ohm/km at 20°C).

title: Switches for Domestic and Similar Fixed Electrical Installations
summary: Mandatory standard for household wall switches, regulating making and breaking capacity, temperature rise, and 40,000-cycle endurance tests.
scope: Applies to manually operated general purpose switches with rated voltage not exceeding 440 V and rated current up to 63 A.

clauses.title: Electrical Endurance Test
clauses.content: Switches shall withstand 40,000 operations at rated voltage and current in a non-inductive circuit without mechanical or electrical failure.

title: Electric Ceiling Type Fans and Regulators — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for electric ceiling fans, governing air delivery (CMM), service value efficiency ratios, blade pitch, and suspension security.
scope: Applies to propeller type ceiling fans with blade sweeps from 600 mm to 1500 mm.

clauses.title: Air Delivery and Service Value
clauses.content: For 1200 mm sweep fans, minimum air delivery shall be 210 m³/min with service value not less than 4.0 m³/min/W.

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services — Part 1: Safety Requirements
summary: Mandatory CRS registration standard for domestic LED bulbs, mandating insulation resistance, creepage clearances, and heat resistance.
scope: Applies to self-ballasted LED lamps with a supply voltage up to 250 V a.c.

clauses.title: Insulation Resistance and Electric Strength
clauses.content: Insulation resistance between live parts and accessible conductive parts shall be not less than 4 MΩ under 500 V d.c.

title: Lamp Controlgear — Part 2-13: Particular Requirements for Electronic Controlgear for LED Modules
summary: Mandatory safety standard for LED power supply drivers, surge protection, SELV output insulation, and thermal overload protection.
scope: Covers electronic controlgear for LED modules supplied from voltages up to 1000 V a.c. or 1000 V d.c.

clauses.title: Insulation Resistance & SELV Isolation
clauses.content: Output circuits intended for SELV must provide reinforced insulation with creepage distance >= 5.0 mm from primary mains.

title: Outdoor Type Oil Immersed Distribution Transformers up to 2500 kVA, 33 kV
summary: Mandatory energy efficiency and construction standard for 11kV/33kV distribution transformers, setting maximum allowable losses at 50% and 100% load.
scope: Applies to 3-phase and single-phase liquid immersed distribution transformers.

clauses.title: Maximum Total Losses Limits
clauses.content: Total losses at 50% and 100% loading shall not exceed values specified in Table 3 (Energy Efficiency Level 1/2/3).

title: Circuit-Breakers for Overcurrent Protection for Household Installations (MCBs)
summary: Mandatory standard for miniature circuit breakers (MCBs), regulating rated short-circuit breaking capacity (10 kA), thermal trip curves, and magnetic instantaneous trip.
scope: Covers a.c. air-break circuit-breakers for operation at 50 Hz with rated voltage not exceeding 440 V and rated current up to 125 A.

clauses.title: Short-Circuit Breaking Capacity
clauses.content: MCBs must successfully clear prospective short-circuit currents up to rated capacity (6 kA / 10 kA) per operating sequence O-t-CO.

title: Residual Current Operated Circuit-Breakers without Integral Overcurrent Protection (RCCBs)
summary: Mandatory safety standard for RCCB earth leakage protection devices detecting 30mA shock currents within 40ms.
scope: Applies to residual current operated circuit-breakers for household and similar uses.

clauses.title: Break Time at Residual Currents
clauses.content: Operating break time at rated residual operating current (IΔn = 30 mA) shall not exceed 0.040 s (40 ms).

title: Luminaires — Part 5: Particular Requirements, Section 1 General Purpose Fixed Luminaires
summary: Mandatory safety standard for fixed ceiling and wall mounted light fittings, ingress protection (IP), and terminal box safety.
scope: Covers general purpose fixed luminaires for use with tungsten filament, tubular fluorescent and other discharge lamps.

clauses.title: Thermal Endurance Test
clauses.content: Luminaires shall withstand thermal endurance test at rated ambient + 10°C for 240 hours without insulation degradation.

title: Luminaires — Particular Requirements, Section 3 Luminaires for Road and Street Lighting
summary: Mandatory standard for outdoor highway and municipal LED street lights, requiring minimum IP65/IP66 weatherproof sealing and 10kV surge protection.
scope: Covers road, street, and public area lighting fixtures.

clauses.title: Ingress Protection & Vibration
clauses.content: Must maintain IP65 minimum enclosure protection and withstand 100,000 cycles vibration test without mechanical loosening.

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries (Lithium Systems)
summary: Mandatory standard for portable lithium-ion and lithium-polymer cells and battery packs, requiring thermal shock, short-circuit, and overcharge safety.
scope: Covers safety requirements for secondary lithium cells and batteries used in smartphones, laptops, power banks, and portable devices.

clauses.title: External Short Circuit Test (Battery)
clauses.content: Fully charged battery pack is short-circuited with <= 80 mΩ resistance at 55°C. Result: No fire, no explosion; max casing temp <= 150°C.

clauses.title: Overcharge Protection Circuit Verification
clauses.content: Discharged battery is charged at 2.0x rated charge current until 1.5x upper charge voltage. Protection circuit must intervene.

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries (Nickel Systems)
summary: Mandatory CRS standard for nickel-metal hydride (NiMH) and nickel-cadmium rechargeable battery packs.
scope: Covers safety requirements for portable sealed secondary nickel cells and batteries.

clauses.title: Continuous Low Rate Charging
clauses.content: Fully discharged nickel cells charged continuously at 0.1 C for 28 days without leakage or explosion.

title: Information Technology Equipment — Safety: General Requirements
summary: Core safety standard for IT hardware, computing equipment, and data processing machinery.
scope: Applies to mains-powered or battery-powered information technology equipment with rated voltage not exceeding 600 V.

clauses.title: Clearances, Creepage Distances and Solid Insulation
clauses.content: Primary circuits to accessible parts must maintain minimum clearance distances per Table 2K and creepage per Table 2N.

title: Audio, Video and Similar Electronic Apparatus — Safety Requirements
summary: Mandatory safety standard for televisions, audio monitors, amplifiers, and domestic entertainment electronic systems.
scope: Applies to electronic apparatus designed to be fed from the mains or batteries for audio/video reproduction.

clauses.title: Fire Enclosure and Flame Retardant Plastic
clauses.content: External enclosures must withstand needle flame test or glow wire test without dripping ignited polymer drops.

title: Safety of Power Converters for Photovoltaic Power Systems — Part 2: Solar Inverters
summary: Mandatory MNRE/MeitY safety standard for solar grid-tied and hybrid photovoltaic inverters, anti-islanding, and DC injection protection.
scope: Covers inverters for use in grid-connected and standalone solar PV power installations.

clauses.title: Anti-Islanding Protection Disconnect
clauses.content: Inverters must automatically disconnect from utility grid within 2.0 seconds upon loss of mains grid voltage.

title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules — Design Qualification and Type Approval
summary: Mandatory quality approval standard for solar photovoltaic panels, thermal cycling (-40°C to +85°C), damp heat, and mechanical load test (2400 Pa).
scope: Covers terrestrial crystalline silicon solar photovoltaic modules for long-term outdoor operation.

clauses.title: Thermal Cycling Test (200 cycles)
clauses.content: Module subjected to 200 cycles between -40°C and +85°C without power degradation exceeding 5%.

title: A.C. Static Direct Connected Watt-Hour Smart Meter, Class 1 and 2
summary: Mandatory standard for digital smart electricity meters with cellular/RF two-way communications and anti-tamper security.
scope: Covers design, accuracy, metrology, and communication requirements for single-phase and three-phase smart meters.

clauses.title: Metrological Accuracy (Class 1.0 & 2.0)
clauses.content: Meter percentage error shall remain within ±1.0% across 5% to 100% rated current load at unity and inductive power factors.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 550, and Fe 600 High-Yield TMT steel bars used across all Indian structural RCC buildings.
scope: Covers chemical and mechanical requirements of ribbed thermo-mechanically treated (TMT) steel rebars.

clauses.title: Mechanical Properties & Elongation
clauses.content: For Fe 500D: Yield strength >= 500 MPa; Tensile/Yield ratio >= 1.10; Minimum elongation >= 16.0%.

clauses.title: Chemical Composition & Carbon Equivalent
clauses.content: Maximum Carbon <= 0.25%, Sulfur <= 0.040%, Phosphorus <= 0.040%. Carbon Equivalent <= 0.42%.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification (33, 43 and 53 Grade)
summary: Mandatory specification for 33, 43, and 53 grade Ordinary Portland Cement, defining 28-day compressive strengths, fineness, and setting times.
scope: Covers chemical and physical requirements of 33, 43, and 53 grade OPC.

clauses.title: 28-Day Compressive Strength
clauses.content: For 53 Grade OPC: 72h strength >= 27 MPa; 168h (7-day) >= 37 MPa; 672h (28-day) >= 53 MPa.

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement — Specification: Part 1 Flyash Based
summary: Mandatory standard for flyash-based Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC) used for general construction and marine durability.
scope: Covers manufacture and physical/chemical requirements of flyash pozzolana cement containing 15% to 35% flyash.

clauses.title: Flyash Proportion and Strength
clauses.content: Flyash content shall be between 15% and 35% by mass. 28-day compressive strength >= 33.0 MPa.

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for structural steel plates, beams, channels, and angles (E250, E350 grades) used in bridges, factories, and PEB buildings.
scope: Covers structural quality hot-rolled steel sections and plates.

clauses.title: Yield Strength and Impact Energy
clauses.content: For Grade E250 (Fe 410 W): Yield strength >= 250 MPa; Tensile strength 410-540 MPa; Charpy impact energy >= 27 J at 0°C.

title: Centrifugally Cast (Ductile) Iron Pipes for Water, Gas and Sewage
summary: Mandatory standard for centrifugally cast ductile iron (DI) K7, K9, and Class C pressure pipes for city water trunk mains.
scope: Covers ductile iron pipes from 80 mm to 2000 mm diameter.

clauses.title: Works Hydrostatic Proof Test
clauses.content: Pipes shall withstand shop hydrostatic pressure test up to 5.0 MPa without sweating or leaking.

title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice
summary: National structural code of practice for plain and reinforced concrete building design, cover to reinforcement, and characteristic strength.
scope: Applies to structural use of plain and reinforced concrete in buildings and civil engineering works.

clauses.title: Characteristic Compressive Strength
clauses.content: Concrete grades shall be designated as M15, M20, M25, M30 up to M80 corresponding to 28-day 150mm cube characteristic compressive strength.

title: Polyethylene Pipes for Water Supply — Specification
qcoReference: Chemicals and Pipes Quality Control Orders
qcoOrder: Chemicals and Pipes Quality Control Orders
summary: Mandatory standard for High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) water supply pipes, graded PE 63, PE 80, and PE 100.
scope: Covers HDPE pipes from 16 mm to 1000 mm outer diameter for municipal and rural potable water conveyance.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Strength Test (100h / 165h)
clauses.content: PE 100 pipes shall withstand 12.4 MPa hoop stress at 20°C for 100 hours without bursting or localized swelling.

title: Unplasticized PVC Pipes for Potable Water Supplies — Specification
qcoReference: Chemicals and Pipes Quality Control Orders
qcoOrder: Chemicals and Pipes Quality Control Orders
summary: Latest mandatory standard for unplasticized polyvinyl chloride (UPVC) potable water pipes, regulating lead-free stabilizers and opacity.
scope: Covers plain and socket-ended UPVC pipes from 16 mm to 630 mm for domestic and industrial water conveyance.

clauses.title: Vicat Softening Temperature (>= 80°C)
clauses.content: Vicat softening temperature of the pipe wall material shall not be less than 80°C per IS 12235 (Part 2).

title: Chlorinated Polyvinyl Chloride (CPVC) Pipes for Hot and Cold Water
qcoReference: Chemicals and Pipes Quality Control Orders
qcoOrder: Chemicals and Pipes Quality Control Orders
summary: Mandatory standard for CPVC pipes engineered for hot and cold water distribution up to 93°C.
scope: Applies to SDR 11 and SDR 13.5 CPVC pipes from 15 mm to 50 mm.

clauses.title: Short-Term Hydrostatic Pressure at 82°C
clauses.content: Pipes shall withstand hydrostatic test pressure of 1.45 MPa at 82°C for 1000 hours without failure.

title: UPVC Pipes for Soil and Waste Discharge Systems Inside and Outside Buildings
qcoReference: Chemicals and Pipes Quality Control Orders
qcoOrder: Chemicals and Pipes Quality Control Orders
summary: Mandatory standard for Soil, Waste, and Rainwater (SWR) UPVC pipes (Type A for rainwater, Type B for soil/waste).
scope: Covers SWR UPVC pipes from 75 mm to 160 mm outer diameter.

clauses.title: Impact Resistance at 0°C (Falling Dart)
clauses.content: Type B pipes shall withstand falling weight impact without shattering or internal crack propagation.

title: Plastic Emulsion Paint — Specification
qcoReference: Chemicals and Pipes Quality Control Orders
qcoOrder: Chemicals and Pipes Quality Control Orders
summary: Mandatory standard for interior and exterior plastic emulsion wall paints, restricting VOCs, heavy metals, and lead pigments.
scope: Covers water-thinnable acrylic plastic emulsion paint for interior and exterior architectural coating.

clauses.title: Wet Scrub Resistance & Lead Content
clauses.content: Paint film shall pass 1000 oscillations wet scrub test; lead content strictly below 90 ppm.

title: Adhesives for Use with Ceramic, Mosaic and Stone Tiles — Specification
qcoReference: Chemicals and Pipes Quality Control Orders
qcoOrder: Chemicals and Pipes Quality Control Orders
summary: Mandatory standard for polymer-modified tile adhesives (Type 1 to Type 4) for fixing ceramic, porcelain, and stone tiles.
scope: Covers cementitious adhesives and dispersion adhesives for wall and floor tiling.

clauses.title: Tensile Adhesion Strength
clauses.content: Type 2 adhesive tensile adhesion after 28 days dry curing shall not be less than 1.0 N/mm².

title: Safety of Toys — Part 1: Mechanical and Physical Properties
summary: Mandatory Indian safety standard for all toys for children under 14 years, strictly regulating choking hazards, small parts cylinders, and sharp edges.
scope: Applies to all toys intended for play by children under 14 years of age.

clauses.title: Small Parts (For Children Under 36 Months)
clauses.content: Toys intended for children under 36 months must not fit entirely inside the small parts test cylinder (diameter 31.7 mm, depth 57.1 mm).

title: Safety of Toys — Part 3: Migration of Certain Elements (Heavy Metals)
summary: Mandatory chemical safety limits restricting bioavailable lead, cadmium, mercury, and arsenic in toy paints and polymers.
scope: Specifies maximum permissible element migration from accessible toy materials.

clauses.title: Maximum Element Migration Limits
clauses.content: Maximum limits: Lead <= 90 mg/kg; Cadmium <= 75 mg/kg; Mercury <= 60 mg/kg; Arsenic <= 25 mg/kg.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
summary: Mandatory statutory standard for all packaged drinking water, defining microbiological limits (zero E. coli, coliforms) and 45 chemical parameters.
scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of test for packaged drinking water filled in food-grade plastic or glass containers.

clauses.title: Microbiological Cleanliness
clauses.content: E. coli, coliform bacteria, Faecal Streptococci, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and Yeast/Mould shall be ABSENT in 250 ml sample.

clauses.title: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) and pH
clauses.content: TDS shall be between 75 mg/l and 500 mg/l. pH value shall be maintained between 6.5 and 8.5.

title: Sports Footwear — Specification: Part 1 General Purpose
summary: Mandatory standard for sports shoes and sneakers, regulating upper-to-sole bonding adhesion, flex resistance, and outsole abrasion.
scope: Covers performance requirements for running, walking, and training sports footwear.

clauses.title: Upper-to-Sole Adhesion Strength
clauses.content: Adhesion bond strength between outsole and upper shall not be less than 4.0 N/mm before and after water immersion conditioning.

title: Insulating Mats for Electrical Purposes — Specification
summary: Mandatory safety standard for elastomeric insulating mats installed in front of high-voltage switchboards and power substations.
scope: Covers Class A (3.3 kV), Class B (11 kV), and Class C (33 kV) non-slip electrical insulating floor mats.

clauses.title: Dielectric Proof Voltage Test
clauses.content: Class A mats (thickness 2.0 mm) withstand 30 kV proof voltage; Class B (2.5 mm) withstands 45 kV; Class C (3.0 mm) withstands 65 kV for 1 minute.

title: Protective Helmets for Two Wheeler Riders — Specification
summary: Mandatory national safety standard for motorcycle helmets, regulating impact absorption tests, dynamic retention strap tests, and penetration resistance.
scope: Covers protective helmets for drivers and passengers of two-wheeled motor vehicles.

clauses.title: Impact Absorption and Headform Acceleration
clauses.content: Peak headform acceleration during drop test onto flat and hemispherical steel anvils shall not exceed 300 g.

title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete — Specification
summary: Mandatory specification for natural, manufactured, and recycled coarse and fine aggregates for structural concrete.
scope: Covers physical and chemical requirements of natural gravel, crushed stone, and recycled aggregates.

clauses.title: Particle Size Distribution (Grading Zones)
clauses.content: Fine aggregate shall conform to Grading Zone I, II, III, or IV sieve analysis per Table 4.

clauses.title: Flakiness and Elongation Index
clauses.content: Combined flakiness and elongation index for coarse aggregate shall not exceed 35% by mass.

title: Hardened Concrete — Methods of Test (Compressive, Flexural & Split Tensile)
summary: Standard test procedures for compressive strength (150 mm cubes), flexural strength, and splitting tensile strength of hardened concrete.
scope: Prescribes sampling, moulding, curing, and compression testing of concrete specimens.

clauses.title: Compressive Strength Determination
clauses.content: 150mm cubes tested at 28 days under calibrated compression testing machine at 14 MPa/min rate.

title: Fresh Concrete — Methods of Sampling, Testing and Analysis (Slump Test)
summary: Standard testing methods for fresh concrete workability, slump cone test, compaction factor, and fresh density.
scope: Covers procedures for determining consistency and fresh properties of structural concrete.

clauses.title: Slump Cone Workability Test
clauses.content: Slump measurement using standard cone (100mm top, 200mm bottom, 300mm height) tamped in 3 layers.

title: Concrete Mix Proportioning — Guidelines
summary: National guidelines for proportioning concrete mixes from M10 to M100, incorporating flyash, slag, and chemical admixtures.
scope: Provides target mean strength calculations, water-cement ratios, and aggregate proportions.

clauses.title: Target Mean Compressive Strength
clauses.content: Target mean strength f'ck = fck + 1.65 s, where s is standard deviation from Table 1.

title: General Construction in Steel — Code of Practice (Limit State Method)
summary: National code of practice for design and fabrication of structural steelwork using limit state design principles.
scope: Applies to all steel framed structures, industrial sheds, and PEB buildings.

clauses.title: Limit States of Strength and Serviceability
clauses.content: Structural steel elements shall satisfy limit state of collapse (flexure, compression, shear) and deflection.

title: Design Loads for Buildings and Structures: Part 1 Dead Loads
summary: Code of practice specifying unit weights of building materials and stored goods for dead load calculations.
scope: Provides unit weights of masonry, concrete, metals, and timber used in building construction.

clauses.title: Unit Weights of Building Materials
clauses.content: RCC unit weight 25.0 kN/m³; plain cement concrete 24.0 kN/m³; brick masonry 19.0 kN/m³.

title: Design Loads for Buildings and Structures: Part 2 Imposed Loads
summary: Specifies live load and imposed load values for residential, office, institutional, industrial, and storage buildings.
scope: Covers floor live loads, roof loads, and concentrated load criteria.

clauses.title: Uniformly Distributed Imposed Floor Loads
clauses.content: Residential rooms: 2.0 kN/m²; office general floors: 3.0 kN/m²; storage warehouses: 5.0 kN/m² minimum.

title: Design Loads for Buildings and Structures: Part 3 Wind Loads
summary: Specifies wind zones of India (33 m/s to 55 m/s basic wind speed), terrain categories, and gust aerodynamic design pressures.
scope: Covers calculation of design wind pressure Vz and design wind force on structures.

clauses.title: Design Wind Speed (Vz)
clauses.content: Vz = Vb * k1 (risk) * k2 (terrain) * k3 (topography) * k4 (cyclonic factor).

title: Criteria for Earthquake Resistant Design of Structures: Part 1 General Provisions
summary: Mandatory standard for seismic zoning of India (Zones II to V), response reduction factors, and design acceleration spectra.
scope: Covers earthquake design principles for buildings, foundations, and non-structural elements.

clauses.title: Design Horizontal Seismic Coefficient (Ah)
clauses.content: Ah = (Z * I * Sa/g) / (2 * R), where Z is seismic zone factor and R is response reduction factor.

title: Ductile Design and Detailing of Reinforced Concrete Structures Subjected to Seismic Forces
summary: Mandatory detailing rules for beam-column joints, confinement ties, shear wall reinforcement, and lap splices in seismic zones.
scope: Applies to reinforced concrete structures located in seismic zones III, IV, and V.

clauses.title: Special Confinement Reinforcement in Columns
clauses.content: Closely spaced rectangular links/spirals required at column ends with pitch not exceeding 100mm.

title: Common Burnt Clay Building Bricks — Specification
summary: Specifies physical and compressive strength classes (3.5 MPa to 35 MPa), dimensions, and efflorescence for clay bricks.
scope: Covers dimensional tolerances, water absorption, and crushing strength of burnt clay bricks.

clauses.title: Compressive Strength Classes
clauses.content: Class 3.5 minimum 3.5 MPa; Class 7.5 minimum 7.5 MPa; Class 10 minimum 10.0 MPa; water absorption <= 20%.

title: Concrete Masonry Units — Specification: Part 1 Hollow and Solid Concrete Blocks
summary: Specifies dimensions, minimum block density, compressive strength, and water absorption for hollow and solid concrete blocks.
scope: Covers solid and hollow load-bearing and non-load bearing concrete masonry blocks.

clauses.title: Compressive Strength of Concrete Blocks
clauses.content: Grade A load-bearing blocks shall have minimum compressive strength of 3.5 to 15.0 MPa.

title: Concrete Masonry Units — Specification: Part 2 Autoclaved Cellular Aerated Concrete Blocks (AAC)
summary: Specifies dry density grades, compressive strength, and thermal conductivity for autoclaved aerated concrete (AAC) blocks.
scope: Covers manufacture and quality requirements of AAC blocks for lightweight thermal-efficient walls.

clauses.title: Density and Compressive Strength of AAC
clauses.content: Grade 1 AAC dry density 551-650 kg/m³, minimum compressive strength >= 4.0 MPa; thermal conductivity <= 0.24 W/m-K.

title: Methods of Tests of Burnt Clay Building Bricks
summary: Prescribes standardized methods for compressive strength, water absorption, efflorescence, and warpage of bricks.
scope: Covers laboratory test procedures for all types of building bricks.

clauses.title: Efflorescence Examination
clauses.content: Bricks soaked in distilled water and dried; efflorescence rated as Nil, Slight, Moderate, Heavy or Serious.

title: Hexagon Head Bolts, Screws and Nuts (Grade C) — Part 1: Hexagon Head Bolts
summary: Mandatory standard for coarse black hexagon head bolts in sizes M5 to M64 for structural and general engineering assemblies.
scope: Covers dimensions, thread tolerances, and mechanical property grades for Grade C bolts.

clauses.title: Mechanical Properties (Grade 4.6 & 4.8)
clauses.content: Tensile strength >= 400 MPa, yield stress >= 240 MPa, minimum elongation >= 22% per IS 1367.

title: Technical Supply Conditions for Threaded Steel Fasteners — General Requirements
summary: General requirements, surface defects, electroplating tolerances, and inspection for threaded steel bolts and screws.
scope: Covers technical supply conditions for all carbon and alloy steel threaded fasteners.

clauses.title: Surface Discontinuities & Cracks
clauses.content: Fasteners must be free from seams, quench cracks, and shear bursts exceeding limits of IS 1367 (Part 9).

title: Steel Tubes, Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Fittings — Part 1: Steel Tubes (MS Pipes)
summary: Mandatory standard for Electric Resistance Welded (ERW) and seamless mild steel pipes in Light, Medium, and Heavy classes (GI & Black).
scope: Covers mild steel tubes from 15 mm to 150 mm nominal bore for water, gas, and plumbing conveyance.

clauses.title: Hydraulic Test & Flattening Test
clauses.content: Every pipe proof tested at 5.0 MPa hydrostatic pressure for 5 seconds; ERW weld seam flattening without cracking.

title: Mild Steel Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Pipe Fittings
summary: Mandatory standard for galvanized and black steel pipe fittings: sockets, elbows, tees, unions, and nipples up to 150 mm NB.
scope: Covers threaded wrought steel and malleable pipe fittings for water and steam systems.

clauses.title: Pressure and Leakage Resistance
clauses.content: Fittings shall withstand internal pneumatic pressure of 0.5 MPa immersed in water without leakage.

title: Steel Pipes for Water and Sewage (168.3 mm to 2540 mm Outside Diameter)
summary: Mandatory standard for Submerged Arc Welded (SAW) and ERW large diameter steel trunk water pipes (Fe 330, Fe 410, Fe 450).
scope: Covers manufacturing, internal epoxy/cement lining, and external coating for municipal bulk water mains.

clauses.title: Mill Hydrostatic Proof Test
clauses.content: Each pipe tested to hydrostatic pressure generating minimum 60% of specified yield stress without rupture.

title: Mild Steel and Medium Tensile Steel Bars and Hard-Drawn Steel Wire for Concrete Reinforcement
summary: Mandatory standard for Grade I and Grade II plain round mild steel bars used for dowels, ties, and RCC reinforcement.
scope: Covers mechanical and chemical requirements of plain round steel bars.

clauses.title: Tensile and Bend Test
clauses.content: Minimum yield stress >= 250 MPa, ultimate tensile strength >= 410 MPa, elongation >= 23% with 180° cold bend.

title: Mild Steel Wire for General Engineering Purposes (Binding Wire & Galvanized Wire)
summary: Mandatory standard for annealed mild steel binding wire and galvanized commercial wire (0.12 mm to 10.0 mm diameter).
scope: Covers wire drawing, annealing, zinc coating mass, and tensile property tolerances.

clauses.title: Tensile Strength & Ductility (Annealed)
clauses.content: Tensile strength of annealed binding wire 300 to 450 MPa; must withstand wrapping round its own diameter.

title: Steel Tubes for Structural Purposes — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for hot-finished and cold-formed ERW structural circular hollow sections (YSt 210, YSt 240, YSt 310).
scope: Covers circular structural steel tubes used for roof trusses, columns, and scaffolding.

clauses.title: Tensile Requirements & Elongation
clauses.content: Grade YSt 310: Yield strength >= 310 MPa, tensile strength >= 450 MPa, elongation >= 14% on gauge length.

title: Hollow Steel Sections for Structural Use (RHS and SHS) — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for Rectangular Hollow Sections (RHS) and Square Hollow Sections (SHS) for architectural frames and structural trusses.
scope: Covers cold formed and welded carbon steel hollow sections from 20x20 mm up to 400x400 mm.

clauses.title: Dimensional & Sectional Tolerances
clauses.content: Corner radius <= 3t; twisting <= 2.0 mm/m; concavity/convexity <= 0.8% of outer dimension.

title: Structural Weathering Steel — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for atmospheric corrosion-resistant weathering steel plates and sections (Corten equivalent).
scope: Covers steel possessing self-passivating oxide barrier patina against atmospheric corrosion.

clauses.title: Atmospheric Corrosion Resistance Index
clauses.content: Corrosion index >= 6.0 based on ASTM G101 calculated from Cu, Cr, Ni, and P elemental composition.

title: Dimensions for Hot Rolled Steel Beam, Column, Channel and Angle Sections
summary: Standard dimensions, sectional weights, and geometric properties of Indian Standard Beams (ISMB/ISJB), Columns (ISMC), and Angles (ISA).
scope: Covers standard profiles for hot rolled structural steel shapes.

clauses.title: Standard Sectional Dimensions and Tolerances
clauses.content: Nominal dimensions, flange thickness, web thickness, and mass per meter shall conform to Tables 1 through 6.

title: Dimensions for Round and Square Steel Bars for Structural and Engineering Purposes
summary: Standard dimensions and mass per linear meter for hot-rolled round and square carbon steel bars.
scope: Covers bar sizes from 5 mm to 250 mm for engineering machining and structural uses.

clauses.title: Mass and Ovality Tolerances
clauses.content: Weight tolerance ±2.5% to ±5%; ovality (difference between max and min diameter) <= 75% of tolerance band.

title: Rolling and Cutting Tolerances for Hot Rolled Steel Products
summary: Standard permissible deviations in length, width, thickness, camber, sweep, and squareness for rolled steel.
scope: Covers dimensional tolerances for steel plates, sheets, flats, beams, channels, and angles.

clauses.title: Camber and Sweep Tolerances
clauses.content: Camber of beams and channels shall not exceed 0.20% of the span length.

title: Cold Reduced Low Carbon Steel Sheets and Strips — Part 1: Cold Forming and Drawing Steel
summary: Mandatory standard for Cold Rolled Close Annealed (CRCA) steel sheets (CR1 to CR5 grades) for deep drawing and automotive stamping.
scope: Covers cold rolled carbon steel sheets from 0.18 mm to 3.20 mm thickness.

clauses.title: Erichsen Cupping and Tensile Properties
clauses.content: CR4 grade: yield strength 140-210 MPa; tensile 270-350 MPa; minimum elongation 38%; Erichsen cupping >= 10.5 mm.

title: Galvanized Steel Sheets (Plain and Corrugated) — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for hot-dip zinc coated plain and corrugated steel sheets (GP & GC) with coating mass from 90 to 600 g/m².
scope: Covers galvanized carbon steel sheets for roofing, cladding, and HVAC ductwork.

clauses.title: Zinc Coating Mass Determination (Triple Spot Test)
clauses.content: Class 120 zinc coating >= 120 g/m²; Class 275 >= 275 g/m² (both sides total) per IS 6745.

title: Continuously Pre-Painted Galvanized Steel Sheets and Coils — Specification
qcoReference: Color Coated Steel Quality Control Order
qcoOrder: Color Coated Steel Quality Control Order
summary: Mandatory standard for pre-painted galvanized (PPGI) and Galvalume roofing sheets with polyester or PVDF protective top coats.
scope: Covers aesthetic pre-painted steel sheets used for building roofing, facades, and wall cladding.

clauses.title: Paint Film Thickness and Flexibility (T-Bend)
clauses.content: Top coat DFT >= 20 microns; primer >= 5 microns; T-bend flexibility <= 3T without micro-cracking.

title: Structural Steel for Fire Resistant Applications — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for thermo-mechanically treated structural steel retaining at least two-thirds of yield strength at 600°C.
scope: Covers fire-resistant steel plates, beams, and columns for multi-storey high-occupancy structures.

clauses.title: Elevated Temperature Yield Strength
clauses.content: Yield strength at 600°C shall not be less than 67% of specified room temperature minimum yield strength.

title: Plywood for General Purposes — Specification (MR and BWR Grades)
summary: Mandatory specification for Moisture Resistant (MR) and Boiling Water Resistant (BWR) commercial plywood.
scope: Covers timber species, urea/phenol formaldehyde adhesives, moisture limits, and glue shear strength.

clauses.title: Glue Shear Strength & Water Resistance
clauses.content: MR grade: cold water soak 16h with shear strength >= 1000 N; BWR grade: boiling water soak 8h without delamination.

title: Marine Plywood — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for premium exterior marine plywood bonded with unextended phenol formaldehyde resin, enduring 72h boiling.
scope: Covers marine grade timber panels resistant to water, fungi, wood borers, and marine organisms.

clauses.title: 72-Hour Boiling Water Proof Test (BWP)
clauses.content: Specimens boiled continuously in water for 72 hours; dry shear strength after boiling shall not be less than 1350 N.

title: Blockboards — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for solid wooden core blockboards for interior and exterior furniture and panelling.
scope: Covers softwood/hardwood battens, face veneers, dimensional squareness, and modulus of rupture.

clauses.title: Modulus of Rupture & Screw Holding
clauses.content: Modulus of rupture along grain >= 30.0 MPa; across grain >= 15.0 MPa; screw withdrawal resistance >= 1200 N.

title: Wooden Flush Door Shutters (Solid Core Type) — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for plywood/blockboard faced solid core flush doors for residential and commercial entrance installations.
scope: Covers slam tests, edge loading, end immersion, and impact resistance.

clauses.title: Door Slamming and Impact Resistance
clauses.content: Door shutter subjected to 100 consecutive severe slamming cycles without splitting of stiles, rails, or face delamination.

title: Pre-laminated Particle Boards — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for melamine faced pre-laminated wood particle boards (Interior & Exterior Grade).
scope: Covers abrasion resistance, steam resistance, cigarette burn resistance, and surface adhesion.

clauses.title: Surface Abrasion & Resistance to Steam
clauses.content: Surface shall resist at least 350 Taber abrasion cycles; surface unchanged after 1 hour boiling steam exposure.

title: Prelaminated Medium Density Fibreboard (MDF) — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for pre-laminated MDF panels engineered from wood fibres consolidated under high heat and pressure.
scope: Covers density, internal bond strength, thickness swelling, and screw withdrawal strength.

clauses.title: Internal Bond Strength & Density
clauses.content: MDF density 650 to 900 kg/m³; internal bond tensile perpendicular to surface >= 0.60 MPa; 24h thickness swelling <= 10%.

title: Dust Pressed Ceramic Tiles with Water Absorption E <= 0.5% (Vitrified Tiles)
summary: Mandatory standard for vitrified and porcelain floor tiles with water absorption strictly below 0.5%.
scope: Covers modulus of rupture (MOR), breaking strength, scratch hardness (Mohs), and chemical stain resistance.

clauses.title: Water Absorption and Breaking Strength
clauses.content: Water absorption <= 0.5%; breaking strength >= 1300 N; modulus of rupture >= 35.0 N/mm²; scratch hardness >= 6 Mohs.

title: Pressed Ceramic Tiles — Specification (Glazed Wall & Floor Tiles)
summary: Mandatory standard classifying ceramic tiles into Groups BIa, BIb, BIIa, BIIb, and BIII based on shaping and water absorption.
scope: Covers glazed ceramic wall tiles, rustic floor tiles, thermal shock, and crazing resistance.

clauses.title: Crazing Resistance in Autoclave
clauses.content: Glazed tiles subjected to 1.0 MPa steam pressure in autoclave for 2 hours without developing surface crazing cracks.

title: 53 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement — High Strength Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for high early strength 53-grade OPC used in prestressed concrete bridges and high-rise RCC columns.
scope: Specifies physical and chemical limits: tricalcium silicate content, Blaine fineness, and setting times.

clauses.title: Compressive Strength (72h, 168h, 672h)
clauses.content: Compressive strength: 72 hours >= 27.0 MPa; 168 hours >= 37.0 MPa; 672 hours (28 days) >= 53.0 MPa.

title: Rapid Hardening Portland Cement — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for rapid hardening cement achieving 3-day strength equal to 7-day OPC strength.
scope: Covers high specific surface area cement for cold weather concreting and rapid formwork turnover.

clauses.title: 1-Day and 3-Day Compressive Strength
clauses.content: Specific surface >= 3250 cm²/g; compressive strength: 24h >= 16.0 MPa; 72h >= 27.0 MPa.

title: Portland Slag Cement — Specification (PSC)
summary: Mandatory standard for eco-friendly Portland Slag Cement blended with 25% to 70% granulated blast furnace slag.
scope: Covers high chemical resistance cement for marine constructions, coastal foundations, and sewer treatments.

clauses.title: Slag Proportion & 28-Day Strength
clauses.content: Granulated blast furnace slag content between 25% and 70% by mass; 28-day compressive strength >= 33.0 MPa.

title: Sulfate Resisting Portland Cement — Specification (SRC)
summary: Mandatory standard for cement formulated with tricalcium aluminate (C3A) limited to maximum 5.0% to resist sulfate attacks.
scope: Covers marine works, foundations in saline groundwater, and effluent treatment tank concrete.

clauses.title: Chemical Composition (C3A Limit)
clauses.content: Tricalcium aluminate (C3A) shall not exceed 5.0% by mass; 28-day compressive strength >= 33.0 MPa.

title: High Alumina Cement for Structural Use — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for monocalcium aluminate cement resisting chemical attacks and temperatures up to 1400°C.
scope: Covers bauxite-derived cement for refractory furnaces and chemical containment floors.

clauses.title: Alumina Content and Strength
clauses.content: Alumina content (Al2O3) >= 32.0%; 1-day compressive strength >= 30.0 MPa; 3-day strength >= 35.0 MPa.

title: Masonry Cement — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for air-entrained hydraulic cement engineered specifically for brick and stone masonry work.
scope: Covers high-workability masonry cement with high water retention and reduced cracking.

clauses.title: Water Retention and Air Content
clauses.content: Water retention shall be not less than 70%; air content of fresh mortar between 12% and 24% by volume.

title: Sand for Plaster — Specification
summary: Specifies grading limits, particle size, and silt content for natural and crushed stone sand used for internal/external wall plaster.
scope: Covers clay and fine silt tolerances to prevent shrinkage cracks in finished wall plastering.

clauses.title: Silt and Clay Impurities
clauses.content: Total silt and clay content determined by sedimentation method shall not exceed 3.0% by mass.

title: Sand for Masonry Mortars — Specification
summary: Specifies grading, maximum particle size (4.75 mm), and impurities for sand used in load-bearing brick and block masonry mortars.
scope: Covers physical characteristics of mortar sands to ensure bond strength and joint stability.

clauses.title: Fineness Modulus & Particle Distribution
clauses.content: Fineness modulus of masonry sand between 1.5 and 3.0; passing 4.75mm sieve 100%, passing 150 micron 0-15%.

title: Concrete Structures for Storage of Liquids — Code of Practice: Part 1 General Requirements
summary: Code of practice governing crack width limits (0.1 mm to 0.2 mm) and impermeability for water storage reservoirs.
scope: Covers design and construction of reinforced and prestressed concrete liquid holding tanks.

clauses.title: Limitation of Crack Width
clauses.content: Design crack width for direct tension shall not exceed 0.2 mm for normal exposure and 0.1 mm for severe exposure.

title: Concrete Structures for Storage of Liquids: Part 2 Reinforced Concrete Structures
summary: Mandatory structural calculation rules for bending moments, hoop tension, and minimum reinforcement in liquid tanks.
scope: Specifies minimum percentage of reinforcement to control thermal and shrinkage cracking.

clauses.title: Minimum Reinforcement in Walls & Floors
clauses.content: Minimum reinforcement shall be 0.35% for high-strength deformed bars (TMT) in each orthogonal direction.

title: Methods of Sampling and Test for Paints, Varnishes: Sampling
summary: Standard sampling methods for liquid paints, enamels, and varnishes from drums, cans, and bulk storage tanks.
scope: Prescribes sampling tools, composite sample preparation, and testing container seal integrity.

clauses.title: Sampling Protocol and Container Preparation
clauses.content: Representative samples drawn using sampling thieves; sealed in clean airtight glass or tin containers.

title: Methods of Sampling and Test for Paints: Mechanical Tests — Cross Cut Adhesion
summary: Standard test procedure for cross-cut lattice pattern paint adhesion, evaluating resistance to flaking from metallic substrates.
scope: Covers multi-blade cutter grid test and pressure-sensitive tape adhesion rating from Class 0 to Class 5.

clauses.title: Cross Hatch Grid Adhesion Classification
clauses.content: Lattice cut of 6x6 squares; tape applied and removed at 60° angle; edges of cuts completely smooth for Grade 0.

title: Ready Mixed Paint, Brushing, Bituminous, Black, Lead-Free, Acid, Alkali and Heat Resisting
summary: Mandatory standard for acid, alkali, and water-resistant black bituminous protective coatings for underground pipelines and steel tanks.
scope: Covers drying time, flexibility (cold bend over 6mm mandrel), water immersion, and resistance to 5% sulfuric acid.

clauses.title: Acid and Alkali Chemical Resistance
clauses.content: Painted steel panel immersed in 5% sulfuric acid and 5% sodium hydroxide for 48 hours without blistering or peeling.

title: Cement Paint — Specification
summary: Mandatory specification for Portland cement-based dry powder exterior wall paints containing waterproofing additives.
scope: Covers white and colored cement paints, water repellency, opacity, and weather durability on masonry surfaces.

clauses.title: Water Permeability and Resistance
clauses.content: Painted test slab shall not allow water penetration exceeding 0.5 ml after 24 hours under 100mm head of water.

title: Enamel, Synthetic, Exterior: (a) Undercoating, (b) Finishing — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for high-gloss alkyd exterior synthetic enamel paint for metal and wood structures.
scope: Covers specular gloss (minimum 80% at 60°), scratch resistance (1500 g load), and accelerated weathering.

clauses.title: Gloss, Scratch Hardness & Lead Prohibition
clauses.content: Gloss at 60° >= 80 units; scratch test >= 1500g without bare metal breakthrough; lead content <= 90 ppm.

title: Enamel, Interior: (a) Undercoating, (b) Finishing — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for interior synthetic glossy enamel, regulating lead restriction (<90 ppm) and hard drying times.
scope: Covers indoor metal and wood coatings, covering power, and color stability.

clauses.title: Drying Time & Lead Content Threshold
clauses.content: Surface dry in <= 3 hours, hard dry in <= 18 hours; heavy metals (lead, cadmium, chromium) restricted under E-Waste / QCO.

title: Caustic Soda (Pure and Technical) — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for Sodium Hydroxide (NaOH) in solid, lye, flakes, and block forms for soap, textile, and alumina refineries.
scope: Specifies purity (minimum 99.5% for pure, 96.0% for technical), carbonate limits, and chloride traces.

clauses.title: Assay Purity and Impurity Limits
clauses.content: Technical grade NaOH >= 96.0% by mass; total carbonate (as Na2CO3) <= 1.5%; chlorides (as NaCl) <= 0.3%.

title: Hydrochloric Acid — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for technical and pure grades of Hydrochloric Acid (HCl), total acidity (minimum 30% by mass), and iron traces.
scope: Covers concentrated aqueous solutions of hydrogen chloride for industrial processing and metallurgy.

clauses.title: Total Acidity & Heavy Metals
clauses.content: Specific gravity at 20°C >= 1.152; total acidity as HCl >= 30.0% by mass; iron (Fe) <= 0.005% for pure grade.

title: Sulfuric Acid — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for commercial, battery, and technical grades of Sulfuric Acid (H2SO4, 98% and oleum).
scope: Specifies concentration (minimum 98.0% for commercial), lead, arsenic, and residue on ignition.

clauses.title: Concentration and Battery Grade Limits
clauses.content: Commercial grade H2SO4 >= 98.0%; battery grade H2SO4 >= 98.0% with iron <= 0.005%, arsenic <= 0.0002%.

title: Laundry Soaps — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for bar and cake laundry soaps, establishing Total Fatty Matter (TFM) grades (Type I: 62% TFM, Type II: 45% TFM).
scope: Covers saponified fatty matter, free caustic alkali limits, and rosin content in laundry soaps.

clauses.title: Total Fatty Matter (TFM) & Rosin Content
clauses.content: Type I pure soap TFM >= 62.0% by mass; free caustic alkali <= 0.2% as NaOH; matter insoluble in alcohol <= 3.0%.

title: Toilet Soap — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard classifying bath and toilet soaps into Grade 1 (76% TFM), Grade 2 (70% TFM), and Grade 3 (60% TFM).
scope: Specifies lather volume (minimum 200 ml), skin dermatological safety, and moisture limits.

clauses.title: TFM Grading & Lather Volume Test
clauses.content: Grade 1 TFM >= 76.0%; Grade 2 TFM >= 70.0%; Grade 3 TFM >= 60.0%; lather volume in standard cylinder >= 200 ml.

title: Household Laundry Detergent Powders — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for active matter content, cleaning efficiency, and phosphate biodegradability in laundry detergent powders.
scope: Covers Grade 1 (high efficiency), Grade 2, and Grade 3 household washing powders.

clauses.title: Active Matter and Cleaning Performance
clauses.content: Grade 1 active detergent matter >= 19.0% by mass; moisture <= 13.0%; cleaning efficiency index >= 100.

title: Paraffin Wax — Specification
summary: Specifies melting point grades (Type 1 to Type 3, 50°C to 65°C), oil content, and color for fully refined paraffin wax.
scope: Covers refined waxes for food packaging wrappers, cosmetics, electrical insulation, and candle production.

clauses.title: Melting Point and Oil Content
clauses.content: Melting point (cooling curve) 50°C to 65°C; maximum oil content <= 0.5% by mass for fully refined wax.

title: Bleaching Powder, Stable — Specification
summary: Specifies available chlorine (minimum 34.0% by mass), stability to heat, and moisture limits for chlorinated lime disinfectant powder.
scope: Covers municipal drinking water chlorination and surface sanitation chemical compounds.

clauses.title: Available Chlorine & Heat Stability
clauses.content: Available chlorine >= 34.0% by mass; loss of chlorine on heating at 100°C for 2 hours shall not exceed 1.5%.

title: Carbon Disulfide, Technical — Specification
summary: Specifies distillation range, non-volatile residue, and sulfur content for technical grade Carbon Disulfide (CS2).
scope: Covers raw materials for cellophane, carbon tetrachloride synthesis, and viscose staple fiber production.

clauses.title: Distillation Range & Purity
clauses.content: Distillation range: 100% distill between 46.0°C and 47.0°C at 760 mm Hg; non-volatile residue <= 0.005%.

title: Acetone — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for pure Acetone solvent (dimethyl ketone), purity (minimum 99.5% by GC), and water content limits.
scope: Covers industrial grade and laboratory grade acetone for acrylic resins, pharmaceuticals, and paints.

clauses.title: Purity and Distillation Range
clauses.content: Purity by GC >= 99.5% by mass; distillation range 55.6°C to 56.6°C; permanganate fading time >= 120 minutes.

title: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations
summary: National safety code for building electrical installations, wire sizing, conduit routing, and circuit breaker protection.
scope: Covers design, erection, testing, and commissioning of electrical wiring up to 1000 V AC.

clauses.title: Insulation Resistance Verification
clauses.content: Insulation resistance between conductors and earth shall be measured at 500V DC and exceed 1.0 Megaohm.

title: Code of Practice for Earthing — Specification
summary: Mandatory engineering code for system earthing, equipment grounding, earth pit resistance, and copper/GI plate electrodes.
scope: Covers calculation of earth fault currents, touch and step potentials, and chemical earthing compounds.

clauses.title: Earth Electrode Resistance Limits
clauses.content: Earth resistance of electrical substation grid <= 1.0 Ohm; commercial building system earth <= 2.0 Ohm.

title: Power Transformers — Part 1: General Requirements
summary: Mandatory standard for ratings, winding taps, connection symbols, and general tolerances for power transformers.
scope: Applies to three-phase and single-phase power transformers of all power ratings.

clauses.title: Losses and Impedance Tolerances
clauses.content: No-load loss tolerance +15%; total loss tolerance +10%; component impedance within ±10% of declared rating.

title: Power Transformers — Part 2: Temperature Rise
summary: Mandatory limits on oil temperature rise (50°C/55°C) and winding temperature rise (55°C/60°C) above 50°C ambient.
scope: Prescribes heat run test and cooling methods: ONAN, ONAF, OFAF, ODAF.

clauses.title: Maximum Permissible Temperature Rise
clauses.content: Top oil temperature rise shall not exceed 50°C; average winding temperature rise by resistance method <= 55°C.

title: Power Transformers — Part 3: Insulation Levels and Dielectric Tests
summary: Prescribes Lightning Impulse (BIL) tests, switching impulse, and power frequency separate source withstand voltage tests.
scope: Covers insulation coordination and dielectric withstand criteria for high voltage power transformers.

clauses.title: Lightning Impulse Full Wave Test
clauses.content: Windings subjected to 1.2/50 microsecond full lightning impulse wave without breakdown or wave deformation.

title: Power Transformers — Part 5: Ability to Withstand Short Circuit
summary: Mandatory requirements for thermal and dynamic electrodynamic stress withstand during external short circuits.
scope: Covers short circuit duration (2.0 seconds) and peak dynamic electromagnetic forces.

clauses.title: Dynamic Short Circuit Proof Test
clauses.content: Transformer shall withstand 9 full asymmetrical short-circuit current impulses without structural winding displacement.

title: Dry-Type Power Transformers — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for cast resin and vacuum pressure impregnated (VPI) dry-type fire-safe indoor transformers.
scope: Covers Class F and Class H insulation, environmental class, and fire behavior test.

clauses.title: Insulation Class & Temperature Rise
clauses.content: Class F winding temperature rise <= 90°C; Class H temperature rise <= 115°C above 40°C ambient.

title: Bushings for Alternating Voltages Above 1000 V — Specification
summary: Specifies electrical and mechanical requirements for outdoor oil-impregnated paper (OIP) and resin-impregnated paper (RIP) bushings.
scope: Covers creeping distance, power factor (tan delta), and cantilever mechanical load.

clauses.title: Dielectric Dissipation Factor (Tan Delta)
clauses.content: Dielectric dissipation factor tan delta at ambient temperature shall not exceed 0.005 (0.5%) at rated voltage.

title: Porcelain Post Insulators for Systems with Nominal Voltages Greater Than 1000 V
summary: Mandatory standard for solid core post insulators used in high voltage outdoor substations (11 kV to 400 kV).
scope: Specifies mechanical bending strength, torsion withstand, puncture test, and artificial pollution test.

clauses.title: Cantilever Failing Load Test
clauses.content: Insulator shall withstand specified mechanical cantilever failing load (up to 12 kN) without fracture of porcelain or cement.

title: Porcelain Insulators for Overhead Power Lines with a Nominal Voltage Greater Than 1000 V
summary: Mandatory standard for disc suspension and pin insulators used on overhead electric transmission and distribution towers.
scope: Covers electromechanical failing load (70 kN to 210 kN), impulse puncture withstand, and thermal shock cycles.

clauses.title: Electromechanical Failing Load Test
clauses.content: Insulators subjected simultaneously to mechanical tensile load and 75% power frequency voltage without mechanical or electrical failure.

title: Low-Voltage Fuses — Part 1: General Requirements (HRC Fuses)
summary: Mandatory standard for High Rupturing Capacity (HRC) low-voltage cartridge fuses up to 1000 V AC and 100 kA breaking capacity.
scope: Covers time-current characteristics, cut-off current, and Joule integral (I²t) energy let-through.

clauses.title: Breaking Capacity Test (100 kA)
clauses.content: Fuses must safely interrupt short circuit current of 100 kA at 1.1 times rated voltage without explosive fragmentation.

title: Low-Voltage Fuses: Part 2 Fuses for Use by Authorized Persons (Industrial Fuses)
summary: Specifies dimensional interchangeability, slotted tags, and knife-blade contacts for industrial bolted and blade fuse links.
scope: Covers DIN and BS type industrial fuse configurations for motor feeder protection.

clauses.title: Power Dissipation Limits
clauses.content: Power dissipation in watts at rated current shall not exceed threshold values specified in Table 1 to prevent overheating.

title: Low-Voltage Switchgear and Controlgear — Part 1: General Rules
summary: Foundational standard defining utilization categories (AC-1 to AC-4), IP degree of ingress protection, and clearances.
scope: Applies to low-voltage electrical circuit control, switching, and protection equipment up to 1000 V AC.

clauses.title: Dielectric Properties & Clearances
clauses.content: Clearances and creepage distances shall withstand rated impulse voltage Uimp (up to 8 kV) per Table 12.

title: Low-Voltage Switchgear and Controlgear: Part 2 Circuit-Breakers (MCCB & ACB)
summary: Mandatory standard for Moulded Case Circuit Breakers (MCCB) and Air Circuit Breakers (ACB), Icu and Ics short-circuit capacities.
scope: Covers thermal-magnetic and electronic trip releases, service breaking capacity (Ics = 100% Icu).

clauses.title: Rated Service Short-Circuit Breaking Capacity (Ics)
clauses.content: Circuit breaker must clear sequence O - t - CO - t - CO at rated Ics and remain functional with full dielectric integrity.

title: Switches, Disconnectors, Switch-Disconnectors and Fuse-Combination Units
summary: Mandatory standard for on-load rotary isolators, changeover switches, and switch-disconnector-fuse (SDF) units.
scope: Covers making and breaking capacity under inductive motor loads (AC-23A) and operational durability.

clauses.title: Making and Breaking Capacities (AC-23A)
clauses.content: Switch must make 10 times rated current and break 8 times rated current at 1.05 times voltage and 0.35 power factor.

title: Contactors and Motor-Starters: Electromechanical Contactors
summary: Mandatory standard for AC power contactors (9A to 800A), bimetallic thermal overload relays, and motor starters.
scope: Covers mechanical endurance (10 million operations), electrical endurance under AC-3 duty, and coil pick-up voltage.

clauses.title: Electrical Operational Endurance
clauses.content: Contactors must endure at least 1,000,000 electrical make-break operations under AC-3 motor starting condition without contact welding.

title: Control Circuit Devices and Switching Elements — Electromechanical Control Devices
summary: Specifies mechanical and electrical durability of 22.5 mm push buttons, emergency stop actuators, and industrial limit switches.
scope: Covers IP65 ingress, positive opening operation of emergency stops, and pilot light LED indicators.

clauses.title: Emergency Stop Direct Opening Action
clauses.content: Emergency stop actuators must feature direct drive positive opening operation (no intervening springs) per Annexure K.

title: AC Static Transformer Operated Watt-Hour and VAR-Hour Meters (Class 0.2S and 0.5S)
summary: Mandatory standard for high-accuracy substation grid meters and commercial HT boundary energy tariff meters.
scope: Covers Class 0.2S and 0.5S metrological accuracy, anti-tamper security, and DLMS protocol communication.

clauses.title: High Accuracy Metrology (Class 0.2S)
clauses.content: Measurement error shall remain strictly within ±0.2% over 5% to 120% rated current across 0.5 inductive to unity power factor.

title: AC Static Watt-Hour Meters, Class 1 and 2 — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for single-phase and three-phase direct connected residential static electricity meters.
scope: Covers electromagnetic immunity (EMC 10 V/m), starting current threshold (0.2% Ib), and voltage surge protection.

clauses.title: Starting Current and No-Load Creep
clauses.content: Meter shall start and continuously record energy at 0.2% of basic current; under no load with 115% voltage, meter shall not register creep.

title: Lamp Controlgear — Part 1: General and Safety Requirements
summary: Mandatory safety standard for electronic ballasts and power controlgear feeding fluorescent lamps, HID, and LED fixtures.
scope: Covers electrical insulation, creepage distances, thermal protection, and fire resistance.

clauses.title: Insulation Resistance & Electric Strength
clauses.content: Insulation resistance >= 4 Megaohms; dielectric test with 2U + 1000 V AC applied for 1 minute without breakdown.

title: LED Modules for General Lighting — Part 1: Safety Specifications
summary: Mandatory CRS standard for self-ballasted and non-self-ballasted LED modules used in commercial and architectural fixtures.
scope: Covers eye safety, thermal management, creepage, and electric shock prevention.

clauses.title: Protection Against Electric Shock
clauses.content: Accessible parts of non-isolated LED modules shall be protected against direct contact with live circuit traces.

title: Luminaires — Part 1: General Requirements and Tests
summary: General construction, internal wiring, mechanical impact resistance (IK rating), and thermal endurance of light fittings.
scope: Covers luminaires for use with tungsten filament, tubular fluorescent, and other discharge lamps.

clauses.title: Endurance Test & Thermal Investigation
clauses.content: Luminaire operated in thermal draught-free enclosure for 240 hours continuously without thermal degradation of insulation.

title: Luminaires: Part 2 Particular Requirements — Fixed General Purpose Luminaires
summary: Specific requirements for fixed general purpose ceiling lights, downlights, and architectural troffers.
scope: Covers mechanical mounting stability, earthing continuity, and gland cord anchorage.

clauses.title: Cord Anchorage Pull and Torsion Test
clauses.content: Cord anchorage subjected to 25 cycles of 60 N axial pull without conductor displacement exceeding 2.0 mm.

title: Photobiological Safety of Lamps and Lamp Systems
summary: Mandatory standard evaluating retinal blue-light hazard, UV actinic hazard, and thermal skin injury from high-power LEDs.
