scope: Classifies lighting sources into Exempt Group (no hazard), Risk Group 1 (low), Risk Group 2 (moderate), and Risk Group 3 (high).

clauses.title: Retinal Blue Light Hazard Exposure Limit
clauses.content: Blue light radiance weighted spectrum Lb shall not exceed 100 W/m²/sr for RG0 (Exempt Group) classification.

title: Method of Electrical and Photometric Measurements of Solid-State Lighting (LED) Products
summary: Standard test procedures for measuring total luminous flux (lumens), luminous efficacy (lm/W), CRI, and CCT using integrating spheres.
scope: Covers laboratory calibration protocols for all solid-state LED luminaires and lamps.

clauses.title: Total Luminous Flux & Efficacy Measurement
clauses.content: Luminous flux measured at (25 ± 1)°C stabilized operating temperature inside 2.0 meter integrating sphere spectrometer.

title: Single-Phase AC Induction Motors for General Purpose — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for capacitor-start, capacitor-run, and split-phase fractional horsepower (FHP) motors up to 2.2 kW.
scope: Covers starting torque, full-load efficiency, temperature rise, and centrifugal switch endurance.

clauses.title: Temperature Rise & Locked Rotor Torque
clauses.content: Class B insulation temperature rise <= 80°C by resistance; locked rotor torque >= 200% of rated full-load torque.

title: Line Operated Three-Phase Induction Motors (IE2, IE3, IE4 Efficiency Classes)
summary: Mandatory energy efficiency standard enforcing IE2 (High), IE3 (Premium), and IE4 (Super Premium) ratings for motors from 0.75 kW to 375 kW.
scope: Covers loss determination per IS 15999 (stray load losses, iron losses, rotor I²R losses).

clauses.title: Minimum Energy Efficiency Values (IE3)
clauses.content: For 4-pole 7.5 kW motor: minimum nominal full load efficiency shall not be less than 90.4% per Table 3.

title: Three-Phase Induction Motors — Specification
summary: Foundational standard for mechanical dimensions, terminal markings, mounting types (B3 foot, B5 flange), and vibration limits.
scope: Covers general industrial squirrel cage and slip ring three-phase induction motors.

clauses.title: Vibration and Overload Withstand
clauses.content: Vibration velocity shall not exceed 1.8 mm/s RMS; motor shall withstand 1.6 times rated torque for 15 seconds without stalling.

title: Code of Practice for Installation and Maintenance of Induction Motors
summary: Engineering code of practice for motor foundation alignment, belt tensioning, bearing lubrication, and insulation testing.
scope: Covers preventative maintenance schedule and failure diagnostics for industrial electric motors.

clauses.title: Shaft Dial Indicator Alignment
clauses.content: Angular and parallel shaft misalignment measured by dial indicator shall not exceed 0.05 mm.

title: Domestic Electric Food Mixers (Mixer-Grinders) — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for kitchen mixer grinders, motor thermal overload protectors, jar interlocking, and blade retention.
scope: Covers electrical safety, motor temperature rise under turmeric load, and noise levels.

clauses.title: Grinding Performance & Motor Protection
clauses.content: Must grind 50g dry turmeric fingers to 300 micron mesh within 2 minutes; TOP must trip before motor winding exceeds 130°C.

title: Safety of Household Electrical Appliances: Particular Requirements for Room Heaters
summary: Mandatory safety standard for electric room heaters, convection radiators, fan heaters, and quartz radiant heaters.
scope: Covers tip-over safety switches, surface temperature limits, and fire hazard prevention.

clauses.title: Tilt / Tip-Over Cut-Off Mechanism
clauses.content: Heater tilted at 15° in any direction must automatically cut off power supply within 1.0 second.

title: Safety of Household Electrical Appliances: Electric Instantaneous Water Heaters
summary: Mandatory safety standard for instantaneous geysers (tankless), pressure release valves, and dry-heating cutoffs.
scope: Covers high water pressure proof test (up to 1.0 MPa), earth leakage, and boiling prevention thermostats.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Pressure Withstand
clauses.content: Water container shall withstand 1.5 times maximum rated operating pressure (minimum 1.0 MPa) without rupture or deformation.

title: Safety of Household Electrical Appliances: Particular Requirements for Heating Liquids
summary: Mandatory safety standard for electric kettles, coffee makers, and liquid heaters.
scope: Covers automatic steam switch shutoff, boil-dry thermal protection, and cordless connector contact endurance.

clauses.title: Boil-Dry Thermal Switch Action
clauses.content: Kettle operated without water; thermal cut-out must disconnect circuit before base temperature exceeds 260°C.

title: Safety of Household Electrical Appliances: Refrigerating Appliances
summary: Mandatory electrical and mechanical safety standard for domestic frost-free and direct cool refrigerators.
scope: Covers flammable refrigerant safety (R600a isobutane), compressor earthing, defroster heater insulation, and condensation drain.

clauses.title: Flammable Refrigerant Leakage Protection
clauses.content: In the event of R600a circuit rupture, refrigerant concentration inside food compartment shall not exceed 75% of lower flammability limit.

title: Safety of Household Electrical Appliances: Appliances for Skin or Hair Care
summary: Mandatory safety standard for hair dryers, curling irons, hair straighteners, and facial steamers.
scope: Covers thermal cutouts, air inlet blockage test, cord flexure endurance, and high voltage dielectric strength.

clauses.title: Air Intake Obstruction Test
clauses.content: Hair dryer air inlet completely blocked with paper; thermal limiter must safely isolate heating coil without casing ignition.

title: Safety of Household Electrical Appliances: Particular Requirements for Electric Fans
summary: Mandatory safety standard for ceiling fans, exhaust fans, pedestal fans, and wall bracket fans.
scope: Covers suspension shackle secondary safety wire rope, blade finger guard probe tests, and moisture resistance.

clauses.title: Finger Guard Enclosure Probe Test
clauses.content: Test probe B of IS 1401 applied with 20 N force shall not touch rotating fan blades through protective guard mesh.

title: Safety of Household Electrical Appliances: Washing Machines
businessTypes: front load and top load plants
summary: Mandatory safety standard for semi-automatic and fully-automatic front/top load domestic clothes washing machines.
scope: Covers spin tub brake interlock (<12 seconds stop time), water overflow protection, and dynamic unbalance vibration.

clauses.title: Spin Tub Lid Interlock Braking
clauses.content: Opening spin basket lid during 1000 RPM high-speed spin cycle must brake drum to complete stop within 12 seconds.

title: Safety of Household Electrical Appliances: Microwave Ovens
summary: Mandatory standard for domestic and commercial microwave ovens, regulating microwave radiation leakage (<50 W/m²).
scope: Covers door interlock switches (dual safety monitors), cavity fire containment, and high voltage magnetron safety.

clauses.title: Microwave Radiation Leakage Limit
clauses.content: Microwave power leakage measured at 50 mm distance from any external surface shall not exceed 50 W/m² (5 mW/cm²).

title: Safety of Household Electrical Appliances: Vacuum Cleaners
summary: Mandatory standard for canister, upright, and wet-and-dry domestic vacuum cleaners.
scope: Covers motor cooling airflow, water ingestion safety, current-carrying suction hose endurance, and radio interference.

clauses.title: Current-Carrying Hose Flexure Test
clauses.content: Electrified suction hose subjected to 40,000 bending cycles under electrical load without insulation puncture or wire severance.

title: Safety of Household Electrical Appliances: Cooking Ranges, Hobs and Ovens
summary: Mandatory standard for electric cooking ranges, built-in ovens, induction cooktops, and ceramic glass hobs.
scope: Covers glass ceramic impact resistance, spillover liquid ingress, and thermostat cut-offs.

clauses.title: Liquid Spillage Over Electric Hob
clauses.content: 0.5 liter saline water spilled over cooking surface; appliance must pass 1500 V dielectric test without insulation breakdown.

title: Safety of Power Converters for Photovoltaic Power Systems: EMC Requirements
summary: Mandatory standard for conducted and radiated electromagnetic emission limits and immunity for solar PV inverters.
scope: Covers CISPR 11 Class A/B emission limits, electrostatic discharge (ESD 8kV air), and lightning surge immunity (4kV).

clauses.title: Conducted Emissions & Surge Immunity
clauses.content: Conducted radio interference on AC mains ports shall not exceed quasi-peak limits of CISPR 11; withstand 4.0 kV line-to-earth surge.

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries for Solar Photovoltaic (PV) Energy Systems
summary: Mandatory standard for deep-cycle stationary batteries (lead-acid and gel) used in off-grid solar rooftop installations.
scope: Covers deep discharge cycle endurance (minimum 1500 cycles at 80% DOD) and ampere-hour efficiency.

clauses.title: Endurance in Solar Deep Cycling
clauses.content: Battery must sustain 1500 charge-discharge cycles at 80% depth of discharge (DOD) retaining >80% initial capacity.

title: Stationary Valve Regulated Lead-Acid (VRLA) Batteries — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for Sealed Maintenance Free (SMF) absorbed glass mat (AGM) and gel VRLA batteries for telecom and data centers.
scope: Covers gas recombination efficiency (minimum 95%), thermal runaway prevention, and self-discharge rates.

clauses.title: Gas Recombination Efficiency
clauses.content: Gas recombination efficiency shall not be less than 95.0% under float charge voltage conditions.

title: Stationary Cells and Batteries, Lead-Acid Type with Tubular Positive Plates
summary: Mandatory standard for long-life tubular lead-acid flooded stationary batteries used in home inverters and power utilities.
scope: Covers spine antimony alloy composition, active material retention gauntlets, and life cycle endurance.

clauses.title: Life Cycle Endurance Test
clauses.content: Battery subjected to life cycles per Table 3; shall achieve minimum 1200 cycles of charge/discharge before capacity drops below 80%.

title: Stationary Cells and Batteries, Lead-Acid Type with Plante Positive Plates
summary: Specifies long-life pure lead solid cast Plante plate stationary batteries engineered for 25-year service life in thermal power stations.
scope: Covers float charge current, high discharge rates, and container transparency.

clauses.title: High Rate Discharge Performance
clauses.content: Battery shall deliver 1-minute discharge rate at 3.0 times C10 current maintaining voltage above 1.70 V per cell.

title: Lead-Acid Storage Batteries for Motor Vehicles (Four Wheelers)
summary: Mandatory standard for Starting, Lighting and Ignition (SLI) automotive lead-acid batteries for commercial vehicles and cars.
scope: Covers Cold Cranking Amperes (CCA at -18°C), vibration resistance, and reserve capacity in minutes.

clauses.title: Cold Cranking Amperage (CCA at -18°C)
clauses.content: Battery discharged at rated CCA at -18°C; terminal voltage shall remain above 7.2 V after 30 seconds of continuous cranking.

title: Lead-Acid Storage Batteries for Two Wheelers — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for compact 12V and 6V starting batteries for motorcycles, scooters, and mopeds.
scope: Covers spill-proof vent caps, rapid charge acceptance, and high vibration resistance on Indian road conditions.

clauses.title: Vibration Endurance Test
clauses.content: Battery vibrated at 30 Hz with 1.5 mm amplitude for 4 hours; no acid leakage, internal plate bridging, or terminal cracking.

title: Test Procedure for Islanding Prevention Measures for Utility-Interconnected Photovoltaic Inverters
summary: Standard laboratory test procedures for islanding protection disconnects in grid-tied solar inverters under tuned RLC resonant loads.
scope: Prescribes testing protocols for anti-islanding trip times (< 2.0 seconds) to safeguard utility line workers.

clauses.title: Resonant Load Islanding Disconnection Time
clauses.content: Under perfectly matched resonant load with Quality Factor Q = 1.0, inverter must cease energizing grid within 2.0 seconds.

title: Thin-Film Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules — Design Qualification and Type Approval
summary: Mandatory standard for CdTe, CIGS, and amorphous silicon thin-film photovoltaic panels.
scope: Covers wet leakage current test, light soaking stabilization, thermal cycling, and hail impact test (25 mm ice ball).

clauses.title: Hail Impact Resistance Test
clauses.content: Module impacted at 11 points with 25 mm diameter ice sphere traveling at 23 m/s without glass cracking or power loss.

title: Solar Photovoltaic Water Pumping Systems — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard under PM KUSUM for solar-powered submersible and surface agricultural irrigation pump sets (1 HP to 10 HP).
scope: Covers minimum daily water output (liters per day per watt peak), MPPT efficiency (>98%), and solar tracking.

clauses.title: Daily Water Output Guarantee
clauses.content: A 5 HP pump powered by 4800 Wp array must deliver minimum 150,000 liters/day from 30m head under standard solar irradiance.

title: Mobile Phone Handsets — Part 3: Indian Language Support Requirements
summary: Mandatory MeitY standard requiring all mobile phones sold in India to support reading and input in all 22 official Indian languages.
scope: Specifies font rendering, virtual keypad layout, and SMS transmission for devanagari, tamil, telugu, bengali, etc.

clauses.title: Text Input and Display in Indian Languages
clauses.content: Phone must display and allow keyboard input of full character sets for all 22 scheduled official Indian languages.

title: Information Technology Equipment: Desktop Printers, Plotters & Scanners
summary: Mandatory safety standard for desktop inkjet printers, commercial laser printers, and architectural CAD plotters under CRS.
scope: Covers heating fuser roller electrical insulation, toner emission, and SELV supply isolation.

clauses.title: Mechanical & Thermal Hazard of Fuser Assembly
clauses.content: Fuser rollers operating at >180°C must be shielded from operator contact; thermal limiters must prevent paper ignition.

title: Information Technology Equipment: Automatic Data Processing Machines (Servers)
summary: Mandatory CRS standard for enterprise rackmount servers, blade chassis, and cloud computing data center servers.
scope: Covers redundant power supply (CRPS) safety, leakage current under multi-cord connections, and fire enclosure integrity.

clauses.title: Touch Current & Earth Conductor Integrity
clauses.content: Maximum touch current for industrial high-leakage rack equipment shall not exceed 3.5% with permanent protective earthing.

title: Information Technology Equipment: Power Adapters for IT & Mobile Devices
summary: Mandatory CRS standard for AC/DC power adapters, USB mobile chargers (GaN and Silicon), and laptop charging bricks.
scope: Covers transformer isolation (3000 V AC withstand), creepage distances, short-circuit protection, and flame-retardant enclosures (V-0).

clauses.title: Primary to Secondary Creepage & Clearance
clauses.content: Minimum creepage distance of 6.0 mm and clearance of 4.0 mm required across optocouplers and isolation transformers.

title: Uninterruptible Power Systems (UPS) — Part 1: General and Safety Requirements
summary: Mandatory CRS standard for online double-conversion and line-interactive UPS systems from 500 VA to 500 kVA.
scope: Covers battery dc reverse polarity protection, backfeed protection relays, and output overload withstand.

clauses.title: Backfeed Protection on Mains Input
clauses.content: UPS shall prevent hazardous backfeed voltage on input AC terminals within 1.0 second of utility mains failure.

title: Information Technology Equipment: Point of Sale (POS) Terminals & EDC Machines
summary: Mandatory CRS standard for handheld credit card POS terminals, payment soundboxes, and biometric banking micro-ATMs.
scope: Covers lithium battery charging circuits, thermal printer safety, and drop impact resistance.

clauses.title: Battery Charging Safety & Overvoltage
clauses.content: Battery management system (BMS) inside terminal must safely terminate charge when voltage reaches 4.25V per cell.

title: Information Technology Equipment: CCTV Cameras and Recorders (DVR/NVR)
summary: Mandatory CRS standard for indoor dome cameras, outdoor bullet IP cameras, and network video recorders (NVR).
scope: Covers Power over Ethernet (PoE 48V) isolation, surge immunity on video ports, and IP66 outdoor weather sealing.

clauses.title: PoE Ethernet Port Dielectric Isolation
clauses.content: Ethernet PoE port shall withstand 1500 V AC dielectric test to chassis earth to protect against lightning transients.

title: Information Technology Equipment: Smart Watches and Fitness Trackers
summary: Mandatory CRS standard for wrist-worn smart watches, fitness bands, and continuous physiological monitoring wearables.
scope: Covers skin contact biocompatibility, lithium coin/pouch battery puncture safety, and magnetic charging pin short circuit.

clauses.title: Skin Contact Temperature & Current
clauses.content: Chassis temperature touching wrist shall not exceed 43°C during maximum compute and fast magnetic charging.

title: Information Technology Equipment: Tablet Computers and E-Book Readers
summary: Mandatory CRS safety standard for touchscreen tablet computers, educational tablets, and digital e-readers.
scope: Covers tempered cover glass impact, high C-rate battery charging thermals, and electromagnetic emission compliance.

clauses.title: Touchscreen Impact Resistance
clauses.content: Screen shall withstand steel ball drop test (50 mm diameter ball dropped from 500 mm height) without glass splintering.

title: Information Technology Equipment: Visual Display Units / LED Monitors
summary: Mandatory CRS standard for desktop LED computer monitors, commercial video walls, and interactive touch kiosks up to 65-inch.
scope: Covers power supply creepage, blue light emissions, stability under tilt, and flame retardant back cover plastics.

clauses.title: Physical Stability Tilt Test
clauses.content: Monitor mounted on desktop stand shall not overturn when tilted at an angle of 10° in any orientation.

title: Lamp Controlgear: Electronic Step-Down Convertors for Filament Lamps
summary: Mandatory CRS standard for high frequency electronic step-down convertors delivering 12V supply to halogen and decorative lights.
scope: Covers short circuit protection, radio interference, and high ambient thermal performance (Ta = 50°C).

clauses.title: Secondary Output Short-Circuit Test
clauses.content: Output terminals short-circuited; convertor shall safely trip via internal PTC/fuse without fire hazard.

title: Audio, Video Equipment: Wireless Microphones and Bluetooth PA Audio Systems
summary: Mandatory CRS standard for portable Bluetooth party speakers, commercial public address amplifiers, and wireless microphones.
scope: Covers acoustic sound pressure level limits (<100 dBA), high temperature amplifier heatsinks, and internal battery safety.

clauses.title: Maximum Sound Pressure Output Protection
clauses.content: Personal audio playback through headphone/speaker ports shall not exceed safe listening limit of 100 dBA without user alert.

title: Low-Voltage Fuses — Specification: Fuses with High Breaking Capacity
summary: Mandatory specification for cartridge fuses with breaking capacity of not less than 80 kA at 415 V.
scope: Covers time-lag and quick-acting fuses for protection of transformers and motor circuits.

clauses.title: Short-Circuit Breaking Capacity Test
clauses.content: Fuse links shall clear prospective fault current of 80 kA at 1.1 times rated voltage without arc flash escape.

title: Direct Acting Indicating Analogue Electrical Measuring Instruments (Ammeters & Voltmeters)
summary: Specifies accuracy classes (Class 0.5, 1.0, 1.5), damping, and overload withstand for moving coil and moving iron panel meters.
scope: Covers AC and DC voltmeters, ammeters, and frequency meters for control switchboards.

clauses.title: Intrinsic Accuracy and Overload Limit
clauses.content: Error at reference conditions shall not exceed ±1.5% of fiducial scale; shall withstand 10-times short-time current overload.

title: Safety of Household Electrical Appliances: Electric Dry and Steam Irons
summary: Mandatory safety standard for domestic dry irons, steam irons, and garment steamers.
scope: Covers soleplate temperature limits, thermostat endurance (100,000 cycles), thermal fuse cut-off, and drop impact resistance.

clauses.title: Thermostat Failure & Thermal Fuse Action
clauses.content: In the event of thermostat contact welding, internal thermal fuse must permanently isolate element before soleplate exceeds 350°C.

title: Packaged Natural Mineral Water — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for natural mineral water sourced directly from underground springs without chemical treatment.
scope: Covers total dissolved solids (TDS), mineral limits, zero microbial pathogens, and hygienic bottling.

clauses.title: Microbiological Safety Requirements
clauses.content: Shall be completely free from E. coli, coliform bacteria, Faecal streptococci, Pseudomonas aeruginosa in 250 ml.

title: Drinking Water — Specification (Potable Water)
summary: National drinking water quality benchmark prescribing acceptable and permissible limits for 65 physicochemical parameters.
scope: Covers pH, turbidity, total hardness, fluoride, arsenic, lead, pesticide residues, and coliform limits.

clauses.title: Acceptable and Permissible Limits
clauses.content: TDS acceptable limit 500 mg/l; total hardness 200 mg/l; fluoride 1.0 mg/l; arsenic 0.01 mg/l per Table 1.

title: Milk Powder — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for whole milk powder, skimmed milk powder (SMP), and partly skimmed milk powder.
scope: Covers milk fat (minimum 26% for whole milk), moisture (maximum 4.0%), solubility index, and scorched particles.

clauses.title: Compositional Limits & Solubility
clauses.content: Whole milk fat >= 26.0% by mass; moisture <= 4.0%; titratable acidity <= 1.2%; total plate count <= 40,000 CFU/g.

title: Condensed Milk, Partly Skimmed and Skimmed Condensed Milk — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for sweetened condensed milk, total milk solids (minimum 31.0%), and sucrose content.
scope: Covers vacuum evaporation, sugar addition, bacterial counts, and hermetic tin canning.

clauses.title: Chemical Composition and Milk Solids
clauses.content: Total milk solids >= 31.0% by mass; milk fat >= 9.0%; sucrose >= 40.0%; yeast and mould <= 10 CFU/g.

title: Infant Milk Foods — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for infant milk foods for nourishment of infants up to 6 months.
scope: Covers milk protein, iron enrichment, vitamin additions (A, D, C, B-complex), and strict pesticide residue limits.

clauses.title: Nutrient Profile & Vitamin Fortification
clauses.content: Protein 12-16% by mass; milk fat 18-28%; vitamin A >= 350 mcg/100g; iron >= 5.0 mg/100g per Table 1.

title: Infant Formula — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for adapted whey-to-casein ratio infant formula replicating human milk nutritional profile.
scope: Covers linoleic acid, alpha-linolenic acid, taurine, nucleotides, choline, and zero pathogenic microbes.

clauses.title: Fatty Acid Profile & Essential Nutrients
clauses.content: Linoleic acid >= 300 mg/100 kcal; whey-to-casein ratio 60:40; Cronobacter sakazakii absent in 100g.

title: Follow-Up Formula — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for follow-up formula for infants aged 6 to 24 months as liquid complementary nutrition.
scope: Covers iron absorption promoters, zinc, iodine, energy density (60-85 kcal/100 ml), and strict heavy metal limits.

clauses.title: Energy Density and Micronutrients
clauses.content: Energy 60-85 kcal/100 ml; protein 3-5.5 g/100 kcal; iron >= 1.0 mg/100 kcal; lead <= 0.02 mg/kg.

title: Milk Cereal Based Weaning Foods — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for roller-dried or extruded cereal-milk weaning mixes (wheat, rice, ragi based).
scope: Covers digestibility, crude fiber limits (maximum 1.0%), moisture, and complete absence of aflatoxins.

clauses.title: Carbohydrate, Protein & Aflatoxin Limits
clauses.content: Protein >= 15.0% by mass; fat >= 7.5%; total ash <= 5.0%; aflatoxin B1 shall not exceed 0.5 mcg/kg.

title: Processed Cereal Based Complementary Foods for Infants — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for baby biscuits, rusks, and dry extruded cereal foods intended for infants.
scope: Covers sodium limits (<100 mg/100 kcal), vitamin fortification, and chemical preservative prohibitions.

clauses.title: Sodium Limit and Texture Safety
clauses.content: Sodium content shall not exceed 100 mg/100 kcal; food texture must rapidly soften on contact with saliva to prevent choking.

title: Carbolic Soap — Specification
summary: Specifies phenolic carbolic acid content (minimum 0.75%), TFM, and antibacterial germicidal strength for carbolic red soaps.
scope: Covers germicidal soaps for general washing and sanitization.

clauses.title: Phenolic Substances & TFM
clauses.content: Phenolic substances as carbolic acid >= 0.75% by mass; total fatty matter (TFM) >= 55.0% by mass.

title: Industrial Safety Helmets — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for industrial hard hats and safety helmets used on construction sites, mines, and refineries.
scope: Covers shock absorption (transmitted force <5.0 kN under 5 kg striker dropped from 1 m), penetration resistance, and 2000V electrical insulation.

clauses.title: Shock Absorption Test
clauses.content: Transmitted force to headform under 5.0 kg drop striker dropped from 1.0 meter shall not exceed 5.0 kN.

title: Personal Protective Equipment: Test Methods for Footwear
summary: Standard test procedures for safety shoe impact resistance, toe cap compression, sole bond strength, and slip resistance.
scope: Prescribes mechanical impact apparatus (200 J energy) and compression machines (15 kN load).

clauses.title: Toe Cap Impact Resistance Apparatus
clauses.content: 200 Joule impact energy delivered by steel striker; minimum clearance under toe cap after impact per Table 1.

title: Personal Protective Equipment: Safety Footwear (200 J Impact)
summary: Mandatory standard for industrial safety shoes equipped with 200-Joule steel or composite protective toe caps.
scope: Covers oil-resistant soles, anti-static electrical resistance (100 kOhm to 1000 MOhm), and energy absorption of heel (20 J).

clauses.title: Toe Cap Impact and Compression
clauses.content: Toe cap shall withstand 200 J impact and 15 kN compression load maintaining clearance >= 14 mm for size 8.

title: Personal Protective Equipment: Protective Footwear (100 J Impact)
summary: Mandatory standard for intermediate protective shoes with 100-Joule toe cap impact rating for logistics and warehousing.
scope: Covers water penetration, upper leather tear strength, and sole flexion durability (30,000 flexes).

clauses.title: 100-Joule Impact Test
clauses.content: Toe cap subjected to 100 Joule impact energy maintaining specified minimum internal clearance.

title: Personal Protective Equipment: Occupational Footwear (No Toe Cap)
summary: Mandatory standard for occupational work shoes without toe caps used in hospitality, healthcare, and electronics cleanrooms.
scope: Covers slip resistance on ceramic tile with NaLS detergent and steel floor with glycerol, and heel shock absorption.

clauses.title: Slip Resistance Coefficient (SRC)
clauses.content: Coefficient of friction shall be >= 0.32 for forward heel slip on ceramic tile with sodium lauryl sulfate solution.

title: Safety of Toys — Part 2: Flammability Requirements
summary: Mandatory standard regulating burning rate (<30 mm/s) of beards, wigs, masks, plush toys, and fabric play tents.
scope: Covers flame spread rates to ensure children can safely discard ignited costumes without burn injuries.

clauses.title: Rate of Flame Spread
clauses.content: Rate of flame spread along soft filled plush toys and disguises shall not exceed 30 mm/s measured per Clause 5.

title: Safety of Toys: Swings, Slides and Similar Activity Toys for Domestic Use
summary: Mandatory standard preventing head and neck entrapment, finger trap pinch points, and tip-over on backyard slides and swings.
scope: Covers dynamic structural strength, stability under 50 kg load, and safety barrier heights.

clauses.title: Entrapment of Head and Neck
clauses.content: Completely bound openings must either be smaller than 130mm (torso probe) or larger than 230mm (large head probe).

title: Safety of Toys: Requirements and Test Methods for Finger Paints
summary: Mandatory standard requiring non-toxic food-grade bittering agents (naringin, denatonium benzoate) to prevent ingestion of finger paints.
scope: Covers restrictions on carcinogenic aromatic amines, azo colorants, and heavy metal limits.

clauses.title: Taste Bittering Agent Requirement
clauses.content: Finger paints must contain embittering substance (e.g. denatonium benzoate >= 4 mg/kg) to deter children from swallowing paint.

title: Safety of Toys: Certain Phthalates in Toys and Childcare Articles
summary: Mandatory standard restricting 6 hazardous phthalate plasticizers (DEHP, DBP, BBP, DINP, DIDP, DNOP) to <0.1% by mass.
scope: Covers GC-MS laboratory testing of PVC toys, teethers, and soft vinyl bath toys.

clauses.title: Maximum Phthalate Concentration Limit
clauses.content: The concentration of DEHP, DBP, and BBP individually or combined shall not exceed 0.1% (1000 mg/kg) by mass of plastic material.

title: Safety of Electric Toys — Specification
businessTypes: RC car and drone toy factories
summary: Mandatory safety standard for battery-powered and transformer-fed electric toys.
scope: Covers maximum operating voltage (<= 24V), battery compartment screw locking, short-circuit fire prevention, and laser safety.

clauses.title: Voltage Limits and Battery Compartment
clauses.content: Electric toys shall operate from safety extra-low voltage not exceeding 24V; battery compartment accessible only via screwdriver.

title: Safety Glass — Specification: Part 1 Architectural, Building and General Uses
summary: Mandatory standard for toughened (tempered) and laminated safety glass used in building facades, railings, and shower cubicles.
scope: Covers particle fragmentation count (minimum 40 particles in 50x50 mm square), thermal shock, and 45 kg shot bag impact.

clauses.title: Fragmentation Test for Toughened Glass
clauses.content: Center punch fracture shall yield not less than 40 granular particles within any 50 mm x 50 mm counting area without slivers.

title: Safety Glass — Specification: Part 2 For Road Transport (Automotive Glass)
summary: Mandatory standard for car laminated windshields and toughened side/rear door glasses.
scope: Covers 2260 g steel ball drop test from 4.0 m, light transmittance (>70%), 10 kg dummy headform impact, and abrasion resistance.

clauses.title: 2260g Steel Ball Impact on Windshield
clauses.content: Ball dropped from 4.0 meters on laminated windshield at -20°C and +40°C; ball must not penetrate glass within 5 seconds.

title: Automotive Vehicles — Pneumatic Tyres for Commercial Vehicles — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for truck and bus radial (TBR) and bias pneumatic tyres.
scope: Covers high speed endurance drum testing (47 hours continuous), tyre plunger energy, and bead unseating resistance.

clauses.title: High Speed Endurance Drum Test
clauses.content: Tyre tested on 1.7m diameter test drum at rated speed/load for 47 hours without tread chunking, ply separation, or bead failure.

title: Automotive Vehicles — Pneumatic Tyres for Passenger Car Vehicles — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for tubeless radial car tyres (T, H, V, W, Y speed symbols).
scope: Covers high-speed wheel drum test up to 300 km/h, breaking energy, and tread wear indicators (TWI 1.6 mm).

clauses.title: High-Speed Performance Test
clauses.content: Tyre rotated under load in steps of 10 km/h every 10 minutes up to declared top speed rating without carcass rupture.

title: Automotive Vehicles — Pneumatic Tyres for Two and Three-Wheeled Motor Vehicles
summary: Mandatory standard for motorcycle, scooter, and auto-rickshaw front and rear tyres.
scope: Covers bead unseating resistance force, plunger breaking energy, and dynamic drum endurance test.

clauses.title: Bead Unseating Resistance Force
clauses.content: Force required to unseat tyre bead from rim edge shall be not less than specified minimum values per Table 3.

title: Copper Strip and Sheet for Electrical Purposes — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for electrolytic tough pitch (ETP) and oxygen-free copper strips (99.90% Cu) used in busbars and motor windings.
scope: Covers electrical conductivity (minimum 100% IACS), tensile strength, and hardness.

clauses.title: Electrical Resistivity and Conductivity
clauses.content: Volume resistivity at 20°C shall not exceed 0.017241 ohm.mm²/m corresponding to 100% IACS conductivity.

title: Aluminium and Aluminium Alloy Ingots and Castings for General Engineering
summary: Mandatory standard for primary and secondary aluminium foundry alloys (A6, 4600, LM6, LM24) for automotive engine and structural castings.
scope: Covers chemical composition, gas porosity X-ray limits, and tensile strength of test bars.

clauses.title: Chemical Composition and Tensile Properties
clauses.content: Alloy 4600 (LM6): Silicon 10.0-13.0%, Iron <= 0.6%; tensile strength >= 170 MPa, elongation >= 5.0%.

title: Wrought Aluminium and Aluminium Alloy Bars, Rods and Sections for General Engineering
summary: Mandatory standard for extruded aluminium alloy 6063 and 6082 bars, angles, and channels (T6 temper).
scope: Covers mechanical strength (yield strength >170 MPa for 6063-T6), Webster hardness, and chemical tolerances.

clauses.title: Mechanical Properties (6063-T6)
clauses.content: 0.2% proof stress >= 170 MPa, tensile strength >= 205 MPa, elongation >= 8% on 50 mm gauge length.

title: Wrought Aluminium and Aluminium Alloy Sheet and Strip for General Engineering
summary: Mandatory standard for cold-rolled aluminium sheets (alloys 19000, 31000, 52000) used for pressure cookers, aircraft skin, and facades.
scope: Covers bend test, tensile strength, and deep drawing Erichsen cupping.

clauses.title: Tensile and 180° Bend Test
clauses.content: Tensile strength per Table 3; cold bend 180° flat on itself without edge cracking or surface tears.

title: Wrought Aluminium and Aluminium Alloy Extruded Round Tube and Hollow Sections
summary: Mandatory standard for extruded aluminium round tubes and hollow profiles for heat exchangers, furniture, and structural frames.
scope: Covers hydraulic internal pressure test (up to 3.0 MPa), flattening test, and dimensional tolerances.

clauses.title: Hydraulic Pressure and Flattening
clauses.content: Tube tested at internal hydrostatic pressure for 10 seconds; tube section flattened between plates to 50% diameter without cracking.

title: Hard-Drawn Aluminium Conductors for Overhead Transmission Purposes (AAC)
summary: Mandatory standard for solid and stranded All-Aluminium Conductors (AAC) for power transmission lines.
scope: Covers wire tensile breaking load, wrapping test, and electrical resistance at 20°C.

clauses.title: Tensile Breaking Load & Electrical Resistance
clauses.content: Individual wire tensile strength >= 160 to 200 MPa; maximum DC resistance at 20°C per Table 2.

title: Aluminium Conductors for Overhead Transmission: Part 1 Aluminium Stranded Conductors
summary: Mandatory standard for stranded aluminium conductors (AAC) with uniform lay ratio and wire count (7, 19, 37 strands).
scope: Covers lay length, joints in wires, and total breaking load of conductor assembly.

clauses.title: Conductor Breaking Load
clauses.content: Rated breaking load of stranded conductor shall be calculated as 95% of sum of individual wire breaking strengths.

title: Aluminium Conductor, Galvanized Steel-Reinforced (ACSR) — Specification
businessTypes: high voltage power grid conductor factories
summary: Mandatory standard for ACSR conductors (Dog, Panther, Zebra, Moose) combining high-conductivity aluminium with high-tensile steel core.
scope: Covers zinc coating on steel core wires, torsion test (minimum 18 twists), and rated breaking strength.

clauses.title: Torsion and Zinc Coating on Core Wire
clauses.content: Galvanized steel core wire must withstand minimum 18 twists in torsion; zinc coating mass >= 240 g/m².

title: Aluminium Alloy Stranded Conductors (AAAC) — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for Al-Mg-Si heat-treated alloy conductors (AAAC) offering high corrosion resistance in coastal areas.
scope: Covers electrical conductivity (minimum 52.5% IACS) and high tensile strength (minimum 295 MPa).

clauses.title: Mechanical and Electrical Properties
clauses.content: Individual alloy wire tensile strength >= 295 MPa; electrical resistivity at 20°C <= 0.0328 ohm.mm²/m.

title: Free Cutting Brass Bars, Rods and Sections — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for leaded free-cutting brass (CuZn39Pb3, Grade 1 to 3) for high-speed automated machining.
scope: Covers machinability index (100%), copper content (56.0-59.0%), lead (2.0-3.5%), and mercurous nitrate crack test.

clauses.title: Mercurous Nitrate Stress Corrosion Test
clauses.content: Extruded brass rods immersed in mercurous nitrate solution for 30 minutes without developing intergranular stress cracks.

title: Cold Rolled Brass Sheet, Strip and Foil — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for 70/30 cartridge brass and 63/37 cold-rolled brass strips for electrical socket clips and radiator fins.
scope: Covers grain size, Vickers hardness, tensile elongation, and deep drawing properties.

clauses.title: Tensile Strength & Grain Size (Annealed)
clauses.content: 70/30 brass annealed: tensile strength 300 to 380 MPa, elongation >= 50%, average grain size 0.025 to 0.050 mm.

title: Hard-Drawn Steel Wire Fabric for Concrete Reinforcement (Welded Wire Mesh)
summary: Mandatory standard for machine-welded wire mesh sheets and rolls used in RCC slabs, precast pipes, and road pavements.
scope: Covers weld shear strength (minimum 25% of wire tensile strength), mesh squareness, and wire tensile limits.

clauses.title: Weld Cross Joint Shear Strength
clauses.content: Shear strength of electrical resistance weld at cross wire intersection shall be not less than 25% of nominal wire tensile strength.

title: Code for Unfired Pressure Vessels — Design, Construction and Inspection
summary: National design code for unfired cylindrical and spherical pressure vessels, joint efficiency, and hydrostatic proof test.
scope: Covers shell thickness calculations, weld radiography, head dishing (torispherical/ellipsoidal), and stress relieving.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Proof Test Pressure
clauses.content: Vessel subjected to hydrostatic test pressure equal to 1.3 to 1.5 times maximum design pressure for at least 30 minutes without leakage.

title: Welded Low Carbon Steel Cylinders for Low Pressure Liquefiable Gases (LPG)
summary: Mandatory standard for 14.2 kg and 19 kg domestic/commercial LPG cylinders manufactured from high-strength micro-alloyed steel.
scope: Covers burst pressure test (minimum 4.0 MPa), water jacket volumetric expansion test, and seam weld radiography.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Stretch and Bursting Pressure
clauses.content: Cylinder volumetric permanent expansion <= 10% under 2.5 MPa; minimum hydrostatic bursting pressure shall not be less than 4.0 MPa.

title: Welded Low Carbon Steel Cylinders for Low Pressure Liquefiable Gases: Above 5L
summary: Mandatory standard for commercial 35 kg, 47.5 kg, and bulk refrigerant gas cylinders exceeding 5 liter water capacity.
scope: Covers weld root bend tests, circular seam submerged arc welding, and heat treatment normalization.

clauses.title: Heat Treatment and Weld Root Bend
clauses.content: All cylinders normalized in furnace at (900 ± 20)°C; circumferential weld root bend 180° around former without crack.

title: Refillable Seamless Steel Gas Cylinders: Normalized Steel Cylinders
summary: Mandatory standard for seamless hot-spun gas cylinders for industrial oxygen, nitrogen, argon, and hydrogen at 150-200 bar.
scope: Covers ultrasonic flaw inspection of seamless shell, flattening test, and hydrostatic proof test at 250 bar.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Proof Test and Volumetric Expansion
clauses.content: Cylinder tested at 250 bar test pressure; permanent volumetric expansion shall not exceed 10% of total expansion.

title: Refillable Seamless Steel Gas Cylinders: Quenched and Tempered Steel (Up to 300 bar)
summary: Mandatory standard for quenched and tempered high-strength Cr-Mo alloy steel cylinders operating up to 300 bar.
scope: Covers low temperature Charpy V-notch impact test (-40°C), burst pressure, and cyclic fatigue testing (12,000 cycles).

clauses.title: Cyclic Pressure Fatigue Test
clauses.content: Cylinder subjected to 12,000 hydraulic pressure cycles between atmospheric and 200 bar without leak or structural rupture.

title: Multifunction Valves for LPG Cylinders — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for self-closing Compact 25.6 mm valves fitted on 14.2 kg household domestic LPG cylinders.
scope: Covers internal excess flow valve, pressure relief valve, seal leak tightness under 1.7 MPa pneumatic pressure, and 10,000 opening cycles.

clauses.title: Pneumatic Leak Tightness Test
clauses.content: Valve submerged in water under 1.7 MPa nitrogen gas pressure for 1 minute; zero air bubble leakage permitted.

title: Valve Fittings for Gas Cylinders — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for wheel-operated brass valves for industrial and medical gas cylinders (Oxygen, Nitrogen, CO2, Argon).
scope: Covers taper thread dimensions, safety burst disc diaphragms, and operating torque endurance.

clauses.title: Safety Burst Disc Rupture Pressure
clauses.content: Bursting disc fitted to valve shall safely rupture between 110% and 130% of cylinder hydrostatic test pressure.

title: Portable Fire Extinguishers — Performance and Construction (Clean Agent, Powder, Foam)
summary: Mandatory standard for portable dry chemical powder (ABC), mechanical foam (AFFF), water, and clean agent fire extinguishers.
scope: Covers fire rating tests (Class 1A to 20A wood crib fire, Class 21B to 233B heptane fuel fire), burst pressure, and discharge range.

clauses.title: Fire Test Rating (Class A Wood Crib)
clauses.content: 4A rated extinguisher must completely extinguish standard 4A wood crib test fire of 120 wooden sticks within discharge time.

title: Dry Powder Fire Extinguishers (Cartridge and Stored Pressure) — Specification
summary: Specifies construction, minimum 85% discharge of contents within 15 seconds, and 2.5 MPa hydrostatic pressure withstand.
scope: Covers sodium bicarbonate and monoammonium phosphate based industrial dry chemical extinguishers.

clauses.title: Discharge Performance and Time
clauses.content: Extinguisher must discharge not less than 85% of total chemical powder within 15 to 25 seconds continuously.

title: Wheeled Fire Extinguishers — Performance and Construction
summary: Mandatory standard for large mobile wheeled fire extinguishers (25 kg to 150 kg dry powder and 50 L mechanical foam).
scope: Covers carriage towability at 20 km/h, 5.0 meter discharge hose, and large industrial flammable liquid fire ratings (233B).

clauses.title: High Capacity Flammable Liquid Fire (233B)
clauses.content: Wheeled extinguisher must completely knock down and extinguish 233B circular fuel tray fire within 60 seconds.

title: Portable Fire Extinguisher, Carbon Dioxide Type — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for 2 kg, 3 kg, and 4.5 kg CO2 fire extinguishers with non-conductive discharge horn for live electrical equipment.
scope: Covers seamless steel cylinder (tested to 250 bar), discharge horn frostbite protection, and Class B/C electrical fire suppression.

clauses.title: Electrical Non-Conductivity Test
clauses.content: Discharge stream directed at 100 kV high voltage metallic plate at 1.0 meter distance; leakage current through horn <= 0.5 mA.

title: Respiratory Protective Devices: Open-Circuit Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus (SCBA)
summary: Mandatory standard for compressed air SCBA sets used by firefighters, chemical spill response teams, and mine rescue crews.
scope: Covers breathing resistance, positive pressure face mask seal, audible low pressure warning whistle, and flame engulfment.

clauses.title: Breathing Resistance & Warning Whistle
clauses.content: Inhalation breathing resistance <= 3.0 mbar; audible alarm whistle must sound continuously when cylinder drops below 55 bar.

title: Respiratory Protective Devices — Filtering Half Masks (N95 / FFP2) — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for FFP1 (80%), FFP2 (94% / N95 equivalent), and FFP3 (99%) particulate filtering half masks.
scope: Covers sodium chloride particulate penetration, paraffin oil aerosol penetration, breathing resistance, and flammability.

clauses.title: Sodium Chloride & Paraffin Oil Aerosol Penetration
clauses.content: Total penetration of NaCl and paraffin oil aerosols through FFP2 filter mask shall not exceed 6.0% (94% efficiency).

title: Medical Textiles — Surgical Face Masks — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for 3-ply disposable surgical face masks (Class I, II, IIR) used in hospital operating theaters.
scope: Covers Bacterial Filtration Efficiency (BFE >= 98%), sub-micron particulate filtration (PFE >= 95%), and splash synthetic blood resistance.

clauses.title: Bacterial Filtration Efficiency (BFE)
clauses.content: BFE tested with Staphylococcus aureus aerosol shall not be less than 98.0% for Class II and Class IIR masks.

title: Medical Textiles — Coveralls for Healthcare Workers — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for viral barrier healthcare coveralls protecting doctors and nurses from infectious biological fluids.
scope: Covers synthetic blood penetration resistance (Class 3), seam tape seal integrity, and moisture vapor transmission rate (MVTR).

clauses.title: Synthetic Blood Penetration Resistance
clauses.content: Fabric and taped seams shall resist synthetic blood penetration at 14 kPa hydrostatic pressure per ISO 16603 Class 3.

title: Medical Gloves: Single-Use Sterile Rubber Surgical Gloves — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for sterile natural rubber latex surgical gloves used in invasive surgical procedures.
scope: Covers tensile strength (minimum 24 MPa unaged), elongation at break (minimum 750%), water leak test, and sterility verification.

clauses.title: Water Leak Impermeability Test
clauses.content: Gloves filled with 1000 ml water; zero droplet pinhole leakage permitted per AQL 1.5 sampling inspection.

title: Single-Use Sterile Rubber Examination Gloves — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for medical examination gloves used during clinical diagnostics and outpatient healthcare.
scope: Covers biocompatibility, powder-free residue limits (<2 mg per glove), tensile strength (14 MPa), and freedom from pinholes.

clauses.title: Pinhole Freedom and Powder Residue
clauses.content: Pinhole AQL 2.5; total powder mass for powder-free examination gloves shall not exceed 2.0 mg per glove.

title: Clinical Thermometers (Liquid-in-Glass) — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for liquid-in-glass clinical maximum thermometers measuring human body temperature from 35.0°C to 42.0°C.
scope: Covers maximum permissible error (±0.1°C), constriction tube reset, and thermal shock durability.

clauses.title: Maximum Permissible Error & Constriction
clauses.content: Error between 35.5°C and 42.0°C shall not exceed ±0.1°C; constriction must maintain reading until shaken down.

title: Digital Clinical Thermometers — Specification
summary: Mandatory standard for electronic digital contact and infrared forehead clinical thermometers.
scope: Covers electronic thermistor accuracy (±0.1°C between 35°C and 42°C), waterproof probe tip, low battery alert, and self-test verification.

clauses.title: Laboratory Measurement Accuracy
clauses.content: Digital readout error calibrated in precision water bath shall not exceed ±0.1°C across 35.5°C to 42.0°C clinical range.

title: Medical Electrical Equipment — Part 1: General Requirements for Basic Safety
summary: National safety code for medical electrical systems: patient leakage current (<10 uA for Type CF), earth continuity, and defibrillation protection.
scope: Applies to all electro-medical diagnostic and therapeutic equipment.

clauses.title: Patient Auxiliary and Leakage Currents
clauses.content: Patient leakage current to earth shall not exceed 10 microamperes under normal condition for Type CF cardiac floating parts.

title: Medical Electrical Equipment: Particular Requirements for Infusion Pumps
summary: Mandatory standard for volumetric infusion pumps and syringe drivers used in intensive care units (ICU).
scope: Covers occlusion alarm pressure detection, anti-free-flow protection, air-in-line bubble detection, and volumetric dosage accuracy (±5%).

clauses.title: Delivery Accuracy and Air-in-Line Alarm
clauses.content: Volumetric flow rate accuracy within ±5%; ultrasonic detector must trigger alarm for air bubbles >= 50 microliters.

title: Medical Electrical Equipment: High Frequency Surgical Equipment (Electrosurgical Units)
summary: Mandatory safety standard for monopolar and bipolar high-frequency (HF) surgical cutting and coagulation cautery generators.
scope: Covers neutral patient return electrode monitoring (REM contact quality), HF leakage current limits, and spark energy control.

clauses.title: Neutral Return Electrode Contact Quality
clauses.content: Return electrode monitor (REM) must cut off HF generator within 50 ms if patient skin contact resistance rises above 150 Ohms.

title: Medical Electrical Equipment: Particular Requirements for Electrocardiographs (ECG)
summary: Mandatory standard for diagnostic 12-lead electrocardiographs (ECG machines) and ambulatory holter monitors.
scope: Covers input impedance (minimum 10 MOhm), common mode rejection ratio (CMRR >= 100 dB), and defibrillation overload recovery (<5 seconds).

clauses.title: Defibrillator Overload Recovery & CMRR
clauses.content: ECG baseline trace must return to screen within 5.0 seconds after 5000 V defibrillator discharge; CMRR >= 100 dB.
